title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
english: NATO and the European Union have condemned Russia following a failed drone attack at Germany's Leipzig airport, which officials have officially linked to Russian sabotage. In response to this escalation, Germany is shutting down a Russian consulate and a cultural center, while Western leaders pledge to increase pressure on Moscow. Russia has denied these allegations and threatened to retaliate against Germany with similar measures.
amharic: የኔቶ እና የአውሮፓ ህብረት መሪዎች በጀርመን ላይፕዚግ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በተፈጸመው ያልተሳካ የድሮን ጥቃት ሩሲያን በይፋ ከሰዋል። ይህንን ተከትሎ ጀርመን የሩሲያ ቆንስላን እና የባህል ማዕከልን ለመዝጋት የወሰነች ሲሆን፣ የምዕራባውያን መሪዎችም በሩሲያ ላይ የሚወስዱትን ጫና እንደሚጨምሩ አስታውቀዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሩሲያ ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ በጀርመን ላይ ተመሳሳይ አፀፋዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni NATO fi Gamtaan Awurooppaa, buufata xiyyaraa Laayipziig kan Jarmanii keessatti haleellaa xiyyara malee (drone) gaggeeffameef Ruusiyaan itti gaafatamtuu akka taate himataniiru. Tarkaanfii kanaan walqabatee, Jarmaniin konsilaa Ruusiyaa fi dhaabbata aadaa ishee cufuuf murteessiteetti; hogganoonni lixaa immoo dhiibbaa Ruusiyaa irratti godhamu cimsuuf waadaa galaniiru. Ruusiyaan himannaa kana haaluun, tarkaanfii wal-fakkaatu Jarmanii irratti akka fudhattu doorsisteetti.

title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin recently issued ambiguous warnings regarding potential military actions against the UK, framing them as state secrets. Analysts view this rhetoric as a form of psychological intimidation intended to deter Western nations from supporting Ukraine. These comments are part of an ongoing pattern of aggressive Russian hybrid operations targeting countries across Europe.
amharic: የሩሲያው ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ላይ ሊወሰዱ ስለሚችሉ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ግልጽ ያልሆነ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ አነጋገር ምዕራባውያን ለዩክሬን የሚያደርጉትን ድጋፍ ለማስቀረት የታለመ የስነ-ልቦና ጫና እንደሆነ ታዛቢዎች ይገልጻሉ። እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ድርጊት በበርካታ የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ላይ እየተካሄደ ካለው የሩሲያ የጥቃት ዘመቻ አንዱ አካል ተደርጎ ታይቷል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii Raashiyaa Vladimir Puutin, UK irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu danda'an ilaalchisee yaada ifa hin taane himaniiru. Xiinxaltoonni yaada kana, biyyoonni dhihaa deeggarsa Yukreeniif godhan akka dhaaban sodaa uumuuf kan yaadame akka ta'e dubbatu. Gochi kun, biyyoota Awurooppaa irratti raawwatamaa jiruun walqabatee, mala Raashiyaan lola ishee itti geggeessitu keessaa isa tokko dha.

title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
english: Data from the Hamas-led health ministry indicates that over 900 people have died in Gaza due to Israeli military operations this year, despite a ceasefire agreement brokered by the United States. While the Israeli military challenges these figures and maintains that its actions are precise and aimed at mitigating civilian harm, UN experts find the casualty reports credible. These findings highlight that violence has persisted in the region even after the peace plan was intended to halt all combat operations.
amharic: በጋዛ በሃማስ የሚመራው የጤና ሚኒስቴር ይፋ ባደረገው መረጃ መሰረት፣ በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢደረግም፣ በዚህ ዓመት ብቻ ከ900 በላይ ሰዎች በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች ተገድለዋል። የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሰራዊት የተጠቀሱትን አሃዞች የሚጠራጠር ሲሆን፣ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎቹ ሲቪሎችን ለመከላከል ጥንቃቄ የተሞላባቸው መሆናቸውን ይገልጻል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና ሌሎች ባለሙያዎች ግን የሟቾች ቁጥር አስተማማኝ እንደሆነ ያምናሉ፣ ይህም በተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ወቅትም ግጭቶች መቀጠላቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministeerri Fayyaa Gaaza keessatti Hamaasiin hoogganamu akka ibsetti, waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa Ameerikaan giddu galeessummaan irra ga'ame jiraatus, bara kana qofa namoonni 900 ol duula waraana Israa'eliin ajjeefamaniiru. Raayyaan Ittisa Biyyaa Israa'el lakkoofsa kana kan mormu yoo ta'u, duullicaa sirrii fi miidhaa sivilii hir'isuuf kan qajelfame akka ta'e ibsa. Garuu, Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi ogeeyyiin biroos lakkoofsi kun amanamaa akka ta'e kan mirkaneessan yoo ta'u, kunis waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa boodas waraanni itti fufee akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect pleads not guilty to murder charge
english: Tyler Robinson has officially entered a not guilty plea regarding the murder of conservative activist Charlie Kirk. The legal proceedings are taking place in Utah, where the defendant could face the death penalty if convicted. The case is currently moving forward through the judicial system.
amharic: ታይለር ሮቢንሰን በተባለው የፖለቲካ አክቲቪስት ቻርሊ ኪርክ ግድያ ወንጀል የተከሰሰው ታይለር ሮቢንሰን ጥፋተኛ እንዳልሆነ በይፋ ተናግሯል። ክሱ እየታየ ያለው በዩታህ ግዛት ሲሆን፣ ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ ከተገኘ የሞት ቅጣት ሊፈረድበት ይችላል። የህግ ሂደቱም በአሁኑ ሰዓት እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Taayilar Roobinsan namicha beekamaa Charlii Kiirk jedhamu ajjeese jedhamee himatamee ture, mana murtiitti yakka itti dhiyaate irratti 'yakka hin raawwanne' jechuun deebiseera. Dhaddachi kun kan gaggeeffamaa jiru naannoo Yuutaatti yoo ta'u, namichi kun yoo itti murame adabbii du'aa isa eeggachuu danda'a. Adeemsi seeraa dhimma kanaa ammatti itti fufee jira.

title: Putin and Zelenskyy issue threats as strikes rock Ukraine, Russia
english: The conflict between Russia and Ukraine has intensified with fresh drone strikes causing casualties across various Ukrainian regions. President Zelenskyy has cautioned international airlines against flying over Russia, claiming his military efforts are intended to force peace talks. Conversely, President Putin has labeled these actions as terrorism and hinted at potential military retaliation against nations supplying weapons to Ukraine.
amharic: በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ በተለያዩ የዩክሬን አካባቢዎች የደረሱ የድሮን ጥቃቶች ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ወታደራዊ ግፊታቸው ሩሲያን ለድርድር ለማቅረብ ያለመ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ዓለም አቀፍ አየር መንገዶች በሩሲያ የአየር ክልል እንዳይበሩ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በበኩላቸው ፕሬዝዳንት ፑቲን እነዚህን ድርጊቶች የሽብርተኝነት ተግባር በማለት በመፈረጅ፣ ለዩክሬን የጦር መሳሪያ ለሚያቀርቡ ሀገራት ሊወሰድ ስለሚችለው ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Waraanni biyyoota Russia fi Ukraine gidduu jiru daran hammaatee, haleellaan doroonii ganda adda addaatti geggeeffameen lubbuun namootaa darbee midhaan qaamaas ga’eera. Preezidaant Zelenskiin dhiibbaan waraanaa isaan taasisaa jiran Russia mariif dirqisiisuuf akka ta’e himuun, xiyyaaronni biyyoota alaa qilleensa Russia keessa akka hin darbine akeekkachiisaniiru. Gamasaaniin, Preezidaant Puutin tarkaanfiiwwan kunneen shororkeessummaa dha jechuun balaaleffataniiru, akkasumas biyyoota Ukrainef meeshaa waraanaa dhiyeessan irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu danda’an ilaalchisee yaada sodaachisaa kennaniiru.

title: Bodies excavated from worst flood-hit district near Nepal-China border
english: Recovery teams are currently searching through mud in Nepal's Rasuwa district to recover bodies following a devastating glacial flood that occurred last week. The disaster has resulted in over 1,100 fatalities across the region. Authorities are conducting forensic operations near the border with China to identify the victims.
amharic: ባለፈው ሳምንት በኔፓል በተከሰተ ከባድ የበረዶ ግግር የጎርፍ አደጋ ከ1,100 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በራሱዋ ወረዳ ጭቃ ውስጥ የተቀበሩ አስከሬኖችን በማውጣት ላይ ይገኛሉ። ባለስልጣናት በቻይና ድንበር አቅራቢያ የሟቾችን ማንነት ለመለየት የሚያስችል የፎረንሲክ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: torban darbe Naannoo Nephaalitti lolaa caba cabbiitiin hordofee uumameen lubbuun namoota 1,100 ol darbeera. Yeroo ammaa kana gareen fayyisuu naannoo Raasuwatti namoota du'anii biyyoo keessatti hafan barbaadaa jiru. Qaamoleen mootummaa daangaa Chaayinaa biratti namoota miidhaman eenyummeessuuf qorannoo fayyaa godhaa jiru.

title: What is Iran’s Castle Breaker missile, used against US bases?
english: Iran is currently using its Kheibar Shekan, or 'Castle Breaker,' ballistic missile to target American military sites in the Middle East, including locations in Jordan and the UAE. This medium-range weapon has a reach of about 1,450 kilometers and serves as a show of strength amid renewed hostilities between Iran, the US, and Israel. The conflict escalated recently after US forces attacked Iranian rocket launchers, prompting Tehran to launch retaliatory strikes using this specialized missile system.
amharic: ኢራን በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ውጥረት ውስጥ 'ካስል ብሬከር' ወይም 'ኸይበር ሼካን' በመባል የሚታወቀውን ሚሳይል በአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ላይ እየተጠቀመችበት ትገኛለች። ይህ ሚሳይል ወደ 1,450 ኪሎ ሜትር የመምታት አቅም ያለው ሲሆን ኢራን ወታደራዊ አቅሟ እንደማይዳከም ለማሳየት የምትጠቀምበት መሳሪያ ነው። ግጭቱ እንደገና ያገረሸው አሜሪካ በኢራን የሮኬት ማስወንጨፊያዎች ላይ ጥቃት ከሰነዘረች በኋላ፣ ኢራን በአጸፋው በዮርዳኖስ እና በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ቤዝ ካምፖች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘሯ ነው።
oromo: Iraan waraana Amerikaafi Israa'el waliin jiru keessatti xiyyaara kombii 'Kheibar Shekan' ykn 'Castle Breaker' jedhamuun buufataalee waraana Amerikaa kanneen biyyoota akka Yordaanosiifi UAE keessatti argaman rukutuuf fayyadamaa jirti. Xiyyaarri kun hanga kiiloomeetira 1,450 dheeratuu kan danda'uufi Iraan humna waraana ishee agarsiisuuf kan itti fayyadamtuudha. Waraanni kun kan hammaate erga humnoonni Amerikaa meeshaalee xiyyaaraa Iraan rukutanii booda, Iraanis deebii isaanii buufataalee Amerikaa irratti xiyyaara kana fayyadamuun weerara gaggeessiteenidha.

title: Palestinian landowners confront bulldozers using their hands
english: Palestinian landowners in the occupied West Bank recently attempted to physically stop Israeli bulldozers from destroying their property. During the confrontation, Israeli forces utilized pepper spray against the residents to clear the area. These demolitions are part of an ongoing series of actions targeting Palestinian homes in the Nablus region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን የመሬት ባለቤቶች የእስራኤል ቡልዶዘሮች ንብረታቸውን እንዳያፈርሱ በአካል ለመከላከል ሞክረዋል። በግጭቱ ወቅት የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ነዋሪዎቹን ለመበተን የቃሪያ መርጫ (ፔፐር ስፕሬይ) ተጠቅመዋል። እነዚህ የቤት ማፍረስ ተግባራት ናብሉስ በተባለ አካባቢ በሰፊው እየተካሄዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbootiin qabeenyaa Falasxiin kan naannoo West Bank jiran, buuldosaroonni Israa'el qabeenya isaanii akka hin diigne harka duwwaa isaaniin ittisuuf yaalaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa kana gidduutti, humnoonni Israa'el uummata bittinneessuuf gaazii ija keessatti facaasu fayyadamaniiru. Diigumsi manneenii kun, naannoo Naablusitti adeemsa walitti fufiinsaan raawwatamaa jiru dha.

title: BBC travels inside occupied Lebanon as officials say Israel expanding positions
english: A BBC reporting team recently visited southern Lebanon to observe the ongoing Israeli military occupation, which now covers about 5% of the country's land. They found that several towns have been destroyed by strikes, and some residents in border communities remain isolated despite a ceasefire. While under strict Israeli military control, the area continues to see expanding infrastructure and a heavy troop presence.

title: Why US troops have a history in this raucous Thai city
english: The USS Abraham Lincoln has arrived in Thailand near Pattaya following a record-breaking 250-day deployment at sea. The city has a long-standing association with American military personnel, rooted in its reputation for vibrant nightlife. This visit highlights the historical connection that has developed between the beach resort and visiting US forces over many years.

oromo: Markabii waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamu guyyoota 250f galaana irra erga turee booda, biyya Taayilaanditti magaalattii Paataayaa bira dhaabateera. title: South Korea jails care home head for sexually assaulting disabled residents
english: A South Korean court has sentenced the former director of a disability care home to 15 years in prison for sexually abusing residents. Following the discovery of this abuse, the government launched nationwide inspections of similar facilities, leading to the closure of the center involved. This case has sparked public outrage and raised serious questions regarding how such crimes remained hidden for an extended period despite existing legal protections.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የአካል ጉዳተኞች እንክብካቤ ማዕከል የቀድሞ ዳይሬክተር በተለያዩ ነዋሪዎች ላይ ወሲባዊ ጥቃት በመፈጸማቸው የ15 ዓመት እስራት ፈርዶባቸዋል። ይህንን አሳዛኝ ክስተት ተከትሎ መንግስት በሀገሪቱ በሚገኙ ተመሳሳይ ተቋማት ላይ ምርመራ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ጥፋተኛ የተባለው ማዕከል እንዲዘጋ ተወስኗል። ክስተቱ በህዝብ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን የቀሰቀሰ ሲሆን፣ ጥብቅ ህጎች ቢኖሩም እንዲህ አይነት ወንጀል ለረጅም ጊዜ ሳይጋለጥ መቆየቱ ብዙዎችን እያስገረመ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mana murtii biyya Kooriyaa Kibbaa keessatti, hogganaan mana kunuunsa namoota qaama miidhamtootaa tokko namoota iddoo sana keessa turan irratti gudeeddii fi miidhaa saalaa raawwachuu isaatiin hidhaa waggaa 15 itti murteesse. title: Bus crash on Egypt's Red Sea coast kills 16
english: A tragic bus accident on Egypt's Red Sea coast resulted in the deaths of at least 16 people, including some Jordanian citizens. Another 28 individuals sustained injuries, prompting a large-scale emergency response involving 20 ambulances. The cause of the crash near the popular tourist area of South Sinai is currently under investigation.
amharic: በግብፅ የቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ በተከሰተ የባስ አደጋ ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፤ ከሟቾች መካከል የዮርዳኖስ ዜጎችም ይገኙበታል። በተጨማሪም 28 ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ አምቡላንሶች ተሰማርተው የአደጋ ጊዜ እርዳታ ሰጥተዋል። በታዋቂው የቱሪስት መዳረሻ አካባቢ የተከሰተው ይህ አደጋ መንስኤው በአሁኑ ወቅት በመጣራት ላይ ይገኛል።

title: Iran, US exchange new attacks: Who was hit in latest strikes?
english: Tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated significantly following a series of major military strikes. Iran claims that a U.S. bombing in the city of Kuhestak targeted a wedding, resulting in civilian casualties, while the U.S. insists it is targeting military sites near the Strait of Hormuz. In retaliation, Iran launched ballistic missiles at several neighboring countries, including Jordan, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Iraq. President Trump has warned Iran of even more severe consequences should they continue to respond to these attacks.

title: Alex Eala cruises into US Open second round, top seed Zverev survives
english: Alexandra Eala secured a comfortable straight-sets victory to advance to the second round of the US Open. American players Coco Gauff, Madison Keys, and Taylor Fritz also successfully moved forward in the competition after strong opening performances.

title: Ed Markey wins: Key takeaways from Massachusetts primary election results
english: In the recent Massachusetts primary elections, incumbent Senator Ed Markey successfully fended off a challenge from Representative Seth Moulton to secure the Democratic nomination. Other long-serving Democratic lawmakers, including Stephen Lynch and Richard Neal, also defeated younger opponents to move forward to the November ballot. Despite calls for a new generation of leadership, voters showed strong support for these established politicians with progressive backing.

title: Video: US energy chief in Venezuela to sign controversial oil deal
english: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright has traveled to Venezuela to finalize an agreement that grants the United States significant control over the country's oil resources. Pireezidaanti Vlaadimiir Puutin gama isaaniitiin, akeekkachiisa kana akka shororkeessummaa mootummaatti ilaaluun, haleellaa Yukreen irratti gaggeessaa jiran itti fufuuf akka murteessan ibsaniiru.

title: US aircraft carrier docks near Thai beach resort Pattaya after record 250 days at sea
english: The USS Abraham Lincoln has arrived in Thailand near Pattaya after spending a record-breaking 250 days at sea. This nuclear-powered aircraft carrier was originally on a short mission but remained deployed due to tensions in the Middle East. The arrival provides relief for the 5,000 crew members while offering a significant economic boost to local businesses in the resort town.
amharic: የዩኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ ለ250 ቀናት በባህር ላይ ከቆየች በኋላ የታይላንድ ከተማ በሆነችው ፓታያ ደርሳለች። መርከቧ በመጀመሪያ ለአጭር ጊዜ የተሰማራች ብትሆንም በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በተፈጠረው ውጥረት ምክንያት ለረጅም ጊዜ በባህር ላይ እንድትቆይ ተገዳለች። ይህ ጉብኝት ለ5,000 መርከበኞች እረፍት ከመስጠቱም በላይ ለፓታያ ከተማ ነጋዴዎች ትልቅ የገቢ ምንጭ ይፈጥራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Markabni xiyyara fe'u kan Ameerikaa USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamu guyyoota 250 emba galaana keessatti erga dabarseen booda, biyya Taayilaand, magaalaa Paataayaa biratti dhaabbateera. Markabni kun jalqaba hojii gabaabaaf kan bobba'e ta'us, naannoo Gogaa (Middle East) keessatti rakkoo uumameen walqabatee bakka sana turuuf dirqameera. Dhaabbanni markaba kanaa hojjettoota 5,000 ta'aniif boqonnaa kan kennu yoo ta'u, qabeenyi isaan magaalaa kana keessatti baasan dinagdee naannichaa guddifachuu danda'a.

title: Germany says Russia preparing ‘hybrid’ attacks over Ukraine support
english: German authorities have linked a recent drone incident at Leipzig Airport to Russian hybrid warfare tactics related to the conflict in Ukraine. While Moscow denies these accusations and labels the evidence as fabricated, German officials remain concerned about potential future sabotage operations. This development highlights growing tensions between the two nations as Germany continues its support for Kyiv.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት በሊፕዚግ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ የተደረገውን የድሮን ጥቃት ሙከራ፣ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ምክንያት የምትጠቀምበት የድብቅ የጥቃት ስልት አካል አድርገው ወስደውታል። ሞስኮ ይህንን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ ማስረጃው የተፈጠረ ነው ብትልም፣ ጀርመን ግን ወደፊት ሊፈጸሙ የሚችሉ ተጨማሪ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃቶች ስጋት እንዳላት አስታውቃለች። ይህ ክስተት ጀርመን ለዩክሬን የምታደርገውን ድጋፍ ተከትሎ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Jarmanii yaalii weerara diroonii filannoo buufata xiyyaaraa Leipzig irratti raawwatame, mala weerara bifa adda addaatiin (hybrid warfare) Raashiyaan deeggarsa Jarmanii kan Yuukreeniif qabdu mormuuf fayyadamaa jirtu waliin wal qabsiisanii jiru. Moskoon himannaa kana kan haalte yoo ta'u, ragaan dhihaate soba dha jetteetti, ta'us mootummaan Jarmanii gara fuulduraatti weerarri akkasii irra deebi'amee akka raawwatamu yaada. Ta'een kun walitti dhufeenya Jarmaniifi Raashiyaa gidduu jiru hammaachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion
english: Prominent Hong Kong democracy activist Joshua Wong has officially admitted to charges of colluding with foreign powers. Wong is currently imprisoned for his involvement in a 2020 unauthorized primary election. He now faces the possibility of a life sentence due to these new legal proceedings.
amharic: የሆንግ ኮንግ ታዋቂው የዴሞክራሲ ተሟጋች ጆሹዋ ዎንግ ከውጭ ኃይሎች ጋር በመተባበር ተከሶ ጥፋተኛ መሆኑን አምኗል። ዎንግ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2020 በተካሄደ ህገ-ወጥ የምርጫ ሂደት ላይ በመሳተፉ ቀድሞውንም በእስር ላይ ይገኛል። አሁን በቀረበበት አዲስ ክስ የዕድሜ ልክ እስራት ሊፈረድበት ይችላል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni dimokiraasii Hong Kong kan beekaman Joshua Wong, dhimma alaa waliin hidhata uumuu isaanii himatanii yakka irratti fudhataniiru. Wong qophiilee filannoo seeraan alaa kan bara 2020 irratti hirmaachuu isaatiin ammayyuu mana hidhaa keessa jira. Himannoo haaraa kana hordofee hidhaa umrii guutuu isa eeggachuu danda'a.

title: Tunisia’s civil society faces growing pressure as crackdown widens
english: Human Rights Watch reports that Tunisian authorities are increasingly targeting civil society groups through arrests, legal prosecutions, and the forced suspension of organizations. Activists, particularly those assisting migrants and refugees, face criminal charges and long-term detention, severely restricting civic freedom. This aggressive campaign marks a significant decline in the democratic space that developed following the country's 2011 revolution.
amharic: የሂዩማን ራይትስ ዋች ሪፖርት እንደሚያመለክተው የቱኒዚያ መንግስት በሲቪል ማህበረሰብ ድርጅቶች እና አክቲቪስቶች ላይ እስርን፣ ክስን እና የእገዳ እርምጃዎችን በማጠናከር ላይ ነው። በተለይም ስደተኞችን በመርዳት ላይ የተሰማሩ ግለሰቦች ከፍተኛ የህግ ችግር እና የእስር ቅጣት እየገጠማቸው ይገኛል። ይህ የመንግስት እርምጃ ከ2011ቱ አብዮት በኋላ በቱኒዚያ የነበረውን የዴሞክራሲ እና የሲቪል ነጻነት ምህዳር በእጅጉ እየጠበበው ይገኛል።
oromo: Gabaasni 'Human Rights Watch' akka ibsetti, mootummaan Tunisiyaa dhaabbilee hawaasa sivilii fi qabsaa'ota irratti hidhaa, himannaa seeraa fi dhorkaa adda addaa cimsee itti fufeera. Keessattuu namoonni baqattoota gargaaran miidhaa seeraa fi hidhaa dheeraa keessa jiru. Gochi kun, booda jijjiirama bara 2011 biyyattii keessatti argamee ture, bilisummaa fi bakka hojii hawaasa sivilii guddina irra ture kan miidhu ta'uun ibsameera.

title: ‘Really terrified’: Milo Yiannopoulos speaks out after deportation from US
english: British commentator Milo Yiannopoulos recently spoke out about his fear and humiliation after being detained and deported from the United States by immigration authorities. Officials stated he was removed for overstaying his visa and failing to attend a mandatory court hearing. Yiannopoulos disputes these claims, suggesting his changing political views might have influenced the government's decision to deport him.
amharic: የብሪታንያው ተንታኝ ሚሎ ያኖፑሎስ በአሜሪካ የስደተኞች ተቆጣጣሪዎች ታስሮ ከተባረረ በኋላ ስለገጠመው ፍርሃትና ውርደት በይፋ ተናግሯል። ባለሥልጣናቱ እርምጃውን የወሰዱት የቪዛ ጊዜውን በማለፉና ለፍርድ ቤት ቀጠሮ ባለመቅረቡ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ያኖፑሎስ ግን ይህንን ክስ በመቃወም፣ የፖለቲካ አቋሙን በመቀየሩ ምክንያት መንግሥት ያነጣጠረበት እንደሆነ ጠቁሟል።
oromo: Qeequun biyya Britaan kan ta'e Milo Yaanoopoolos, biyya Ameerikaa keessatti qabamee erga ari'amee booda waa'ee sodaafi qaana isatti dhaga'ame ibseera. Aangeyyoonni biyyattii tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame visa isaa xumuratee fi beellama mana murtiitti waan hin dhiyaanneef ta'uu dubbatu. Yaanoopoolos garuu himannaa kana haaluun, jijjiirama yaada siyaasaa isaatiin walqabatee mootummaan irratti xiyyeeffachuu danda'a jedhee shakka.

title: US strikes on Iran kill child at wedding ceremony
english: A recent United States military strike near the Iranian port city of Sirik has resulted in at least five deaths, including a young child. The attack targeted a wedding celebration, leaving many other guests injured. The incident has drawn significant attention due to the high civilian casualty toll at a festive event.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በኢራን ሲሪክ ወደብ አቅራቢያ ባደረሱት ጥቃት አንድ ሕፃንን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በሰርግ ሥነ ሥርዓት ላይ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በሠርግ ላይ በመድረሱ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት አግኝቷል።
oromo: Humni waraana Ameerikaa magaalaa buufata doonii Siiriik jedhamtu naannawaa Iraanitti haleellaa raawwateen daa'ima tokko dabalatee namoonni shan du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame sirna cidhaa tokko irratti yoo ta'u, namoonni hedduunis miidhamaniiru. Gochi kun sirna gammachuu irratti raawwatamuun isaa yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Iran war live: US bombs Iran, Tehran retaliates on Gulf neighbours, Jordan
english: The United States recently conducted military strikes against Iranian targets, claiming the move was necessary to protect its personnel and shipping interests from the IRGC. In retaliation, Iran launched ballistic missiles at US and coalition bases in Jordan, resulting in heightened tensions. Iran's leadership has vowed further consequences for Washington following the casualties caused by the initial American attacks.
amharic: አሜሪካ የራሷን ሠራተኞች እና የባህር ላይ ትራንስፖርት ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ በሚል በኢራን ኢላማዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። ለዚህ ምላሽ ኢራን በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ እና የሕብረት ኃይሎች መሠረት ላይ በባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ሰንዝራለች። የኢራን መሪዎች በአሜሪካ ጥቃት ለደረሰው ጉዳት ዋሽንግተን ተገቢውን ትምህርት እንደምታገኝ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ameerikaan hojjattootasaa fi qabeenyasaa eeguuf jechuun lafa tajaajila waraanaa Iraan irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatteetti. Kana hordofee, Iraan buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa fi michootashee kan Yordaanos keessa jiran irratti xiyyaara kombiitii (ballistic missiles) fayyadamuun haleelleetti. Hogganoonni Iraan, haleellaa jalqabaa Ameerikaan raawwatteen lubbuun darbuusaatti aaruun, Washington irratti tarkaanfiin gara fuulduraa akka fudhatamu dubbataniiru.

title: Fernandez transfers to Man City from Chelsea in joint British record fee
english: Manchester City has completed the signing of Argentine midfielder Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea for 125 million pounds. This transfer matches the British record fee, following a high-pressure deal finalized just before the summer window closed. Fernandez, a 2026 World Cup finalist, joins City as part of the team's midfield rebuild under manager Enzo Maresca.
amharic: ማንቸስተር ሲቲ አርጀንቲናዊውን አማካይ ኤንዞ ፈርናንዴዝን ከቼልሲ በ125 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ በሆነ የዝውውር ሂሳብ ማስፈረሙን አረጋግጧል። ይህ ዝውውር የብሪታንያ የዝውውር ሪከርድን እኩል ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የተጠናቀቀውም የዝውውር መስኮቱ ሊዘጋ ጥቂት ደቂቃዎች ሲቀሩት ነው። የ2026 የዓለም ዋንጫ የፍጻሜ ተፋላሚ የሆነው ፈርናንዴዝ፣ በአሰልጣኝ ኢንዞ ማሬስካ የሚመራው የማንቸስተር ሲቲ አማካይ ክፍልን ይቀላቀላል።
oromo: Maanchistar Siitii taphataa giddugaleessa Arjantiinaa Enzoo Fernaandez Chelsea irraa paawundii miiliyoona 125n gara gartuu isaatti dabaleera. Waliigalteen kun rikardii biyyattii kan cabse yoo ta'u, xumura yeroo gabaa dabarsaa taphattootaa irratti kan raawwatamedha. Fernaandez taphataa dorgommii waancaa addunyaa bara 2026 irratti hirmaate yoo ta'u, maanchistar siitiitti kan makame leenjisaa Enzoo Maareskaa jalatti taphachuufidha.

title: Cisco accused of fostering a hostile workplace for Muslim and Arab employees
english: The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission has determined that Cisco likely created a hostile work environment for Muslim and Arab employees. This follows complaints from a staff group regarding workplace harassment after they publicly opposed the company's technology sales to the Israeli military. Allegations include that management failed to address hate speech and discriminatory comments directed at these employees on internal messaging platforms.
amharic: የአሜሪካ እኩል የስራ እድል ኮሚሽን ሲስኮ በሙስሊም እና በአረብ ሰራተኞቹ ላይ አድልዎ የተሞላበት የስራ አካባቢ ፈጥሯል የሚል ውሳኔ አስተላልፏል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ኩባንያው ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ቴክኖሎጂ መሸጡን የተቃወሙ ሰራተኞች በስራ ቦታቸው ላይ ደርሶብናል ባሉት እንግልት ምክንያት ባቀረቡት አቤቱታ ነው። ሰራተኞቹ በአካባቢያዊ የመልእክት መላላኪያ መድረኮች ላይ የሚሰነዘርባቸውን የጥላቻ ንግግሮች ማኔጅመንቱ ችላ ማለቱን ከሰዋል።
oromo: Komishiniin Carraa Hojii Walqixa US, dhaabbanni Cisco hojjettoota isaa warra Muslimaa fi Araboota ta’an irratti qilleensa hojii jibbinsa qabu uumuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Himannaan kun kan dhufe, hojjettoonni dhaabbatichi Israa’elitti meeshaalee teeknoolojii gurguruu isaa mormuun isaanii booda miidhaan garaagaraa akka irra ga’e himachuun isaanii boodadha. Hojjettoonni kun, dhaabbatichi keessaatti waldaalee hojjettootaa irratti yaada jibbinsaa fi qeeqqa irratti fudhatamee ture irratti tarkaanfiin barbaachisaa akka hin fudhatamne himatu.

title: US House passes funding bill to avert government shutdown ahead of midterms
english: The U.S. House of Representatives has approved a temporary funding bill to keep federal operations running until December 11, successfully avoiding a government shutdown. This short-term measure provides lawmakers with extra time to negotiate full-year spending plans for the 2027 fiscal year. The move is particularly significant as it prevents potential political disruption immediately before the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት የፌዴራል መንግስት ስራዎች እስከ ታህሳስ 11 እንዲቀጥሉ የሚያስችል ጊዜያዊ የበጀት ማሻሻያ አጽድቋል። ይህ እርምጃ የመንግስት ስራ መስተጓጎልን ለመከላከል የሚያስችል ሲሆን፣ ህግ አውጪዎች ለ2027 በጀት ዓመት የሚሆን አጠቃላይ እቅድ ለመደራደር ጊዜ እንዲያገኙ ያስችላቸዋል። ውሳኔው ከመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ በፊት ሊፈጠር የሚችለውን የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ለማስወገድ ወሳኝ ነው።
oromo: Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummata Amerikaa kan ta'e, hojiin mootummaa federaalaa hanga mudde 11tti akka hin dhaabanneef baajata yerootii tokko raggaaseera. Murtii yerootii kana gara fuulduraatti karoora baajata guutuu kan waggaa 2027 irratti mari'achuuf yeroo gahaa kan kennu dha. Tarkaanfiin kun filannoo gama gidduu dhufuun dura rakkoo siyaasaa keessaatti uumamuu danda'u ittisuuf gargaara.

title: IRGC claims strikes on US facilities in Iraq's Erbil
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps recently conducted missile and drone attacks against American-linked facilities in Erbil, Iraq. The operation reportedly caused significant damage to logistics infrastructure, fuel storage, and surveillance equipment used by the United States. Iranian officials declared these strikes a direct challenge to American influence in the region.
amharic: የኢራኑ እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል በኢራቅ ኤርቢል በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ተቋማት ላይ የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አድርሷል። ጥቃቱ በአሜሪካ ስራ ላይ የዋሉ የነዳጅ ማከማቻዎችን፣ የሎጂስቲክስ ማዕከላትን እና የክትትል መሳሪያዎችን አውድሟል። ኢራን ይህንን እርምጃ የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ ለመቃወም የተወሰደ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Humnoonni Waraana Iran (IRGC) magaalaa Erbil kan Itoophiyaa keessatti argamuutti buufataalee Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa misa'elaa fi doonii geggeessaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan dhaabbataalee gargaarsaa, qodaa boba'aa fi meeshaaleen hordoffii Ameerikaa kan barbada'an yoo ta'u, mootummaan Iranis gochi kun dhiibbaa Ameerikaa naannichaa hir'isuuf akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Bahrain says air defence systems intercepted Iranian drones
english: Bahrain announced that its military successfully used air defense systems to stop and destroy several drones originating from Iran. These unmanned aircraft were identified as being directed toward the nation. No further details regarding damages or injuries have been released following the interception.
amharic: የባህሬን መከላከያ ሰራዊት ከአይራን የተላኩ ድሮኖችን በአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች አማካኝነት መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ድሮኖች በሀገሪቱ ላይ ያነጣጠሩ እንደነበሩ የሀገሪቱ የመንግስት ዜና አገልግሎት ዘግቧል። ስለ ጉዳቱ ወይም ስለ ሌላ ዝርዝር መረጃ እስካሁን የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Bahrain qilleensa ishee irraatti kan ergaman xiyyoowwan nama hin feene (drones) kan Iran irraa dhufan sirna ittisa qilleensaatiin rukuttee gatuushee beeksiste. Drononni kun biyyattii irratti xiyyeeffatanii kan dhufan ta'uu gabaasni oduu mootummaa ibseera. Hanga ammaa miidhaan gahuu isaa ykn odeeffannoo dabalataa waa'ee rukuttaa kanaa kan ibsame hin jiru.

title: Air raid sirens ring out in Bahrain
english: Early Wednesday morning, air raid sirens were activated across Bahrain. The country's interior ministry urged all citizens to stay composed and move immediately to designated secure locations. Officials are currently managing the situation to ensure public safety.
amharic: ረቡዕ ማለዳ በባህሬን የአየር ጥቃት ማስጠንቀቂያ ደወሎች ተሰምተዋል። የሀገሪቱ የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ነዋሪዎች መረጋጋት እንዲጠብቁ እና በአቅራቢያቸው ወደሚገኝ አስተማማኝ ቦታ እንዲጠለሉ አሳስቧል። ባለስልጣናት የህዝብን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ሁኔታውን እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Guyyaa Arba'aa ganama keessa biyya Bahreyn keessatti sagaleen akeekkachiisa haleellaa qilleensa irraa dhaga'ameera. Ministeerri dhimma keessaa biyyattii jiraattonni tasgabbii akka qabaatan fi battalatti gara bakka tasgabbii qabutti akka deeman dhaameera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa nageenya ummataa eeguuf haala jiru hordofaa jiru.

title: Iran says it will respond ‘with firmness’ after Sirik attack
english: Iranian official Esmaeil Baqaei has vowed a firm response following a recent U.S. airstrike on a residential home in Sirik that reportedly killed or injured over 50 civilians during a wedding celebration. Despite warnings from President Donald Trump regarding potential retaliation, Iran condemned the attack as an atrocity and criticized the international community for its lack of action. Tehran further warned that those who remain silent regarding these military actions will eventually face the consequences of their indifference.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ ኢስማኤል ባቃኢ በሲሪክ ከተማ በሠርግ ላይ በደረሰ የአሜሪካ የአየር ጥቃት ከ50 በላይ ንፁሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን ተከትሎ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኢራን የበቀል እርምጃ ከፍተኛ መዘዝ እንደሚያስከትል ማስጠንቀቂያ ቢሰጡም፣ ኢራን ጥቃቱን እንደ ጭካኔ ድርጊት አውግዛለች። በተጨማሪም፣ ይህንን ጥቃት ዝም ብለው ለሚመለከቱ ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት እና መንግስታት፣ የዝምታቸው ውጤት ወደፊት እንደሚመለስባቸው ኢራን አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan Isma’el Baqa’ii, haleellaa qilleensa irraa Ameerikaan magaalaa Sirikitti mana jireenyaa tokkorratti raawwattee fi cidha irratti namoota 50 ol ajjeese ykn madeesse sana booda, Iraan tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf akka qophoofte ibsaniiru. Preezdaant Doonaald Tiraamp Iraan deebii yoo kennite tarkaanfii hamaa akka fudhatan akeekkachiisanis, Iraan haleellicha yakka suukanneessaa jechuun balaaleffatteetti. Kana malees, Iraan biyyoonniifi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa haleellicha irratti cal’isuun isaanii giddu-galeessa ta’uu miti jechuun, namoonni cal’isan kunis gara fuulduraatti bu’aa kanaa akka dhamdhaman akeekkachiisteetti.

title: US urges G20 to cut trade imbalances, focus on China
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is calling on G20 nations to adopt stronger trade protections to shield their domestic industries from a flood of cheap Chinese goods. He argues that China's aggressive export strategy is draining global economic growth and causing significant trade imbalances. Bessent suggests that other countries should follow the US example by implementing tariffs to safeguard their local jobs and businesses.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት የጂ-20 አገራት የሀገር ውስጥ ኢንዱስትሪዎቻቸውን ከቻይና ርካሽ ምርቶች ለመከላከል ጠንካራ የንግድ እርምጃዎችን እንዲወስዱ አሳስበዋል። የቻይና ከመጠን ያለፈ የኤክስፖርት እንቅስቃሴ በአለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ እድገት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሌሎች አገራትም የአሜሪካን አርአያ በመከተል የራሳቸውን የስራ እድል እና ኢኮኖሚ ለመጠበቅ ታሪፍ ሊጥሉ እንደሚገባ አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Scott Bessent, biyyoonni G20 industirii biyya isaanii oomishaaleen Chaayinaa gatii hir'uu ta'an irraa ittisuuf tarkaanfii daldalaa cimaa akka fudhatan gorsaniiru. Oomishaaleen Chaayinaa addunyaa guutuu keessatti baay'achuun isaanii guddina dinagdee addunyaa miidhaa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni biroos hojii fi dinagdee isaanii eeggachuuf, akka Ameerikaatti gibira daldalaa (tariffs) akka kaa'an yaadachiisaniiru.

title: US energy secretary will travel to Venezuela to unveil oil arrangement
english: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright is visiting Venezuela to finalize a controversial agreement that grants the United States control over a significant portion of the country's oil reserves. Under this century-long deal, the US will partner with a private firm to extract oil from 17 major fields, a move the US claims will secure reliable energy supplies. While the Venezuelan government supports the arrangement to boost its economy, opposition lawmakers are criticizing the lack of transparency regarding the specific terms of the agreement.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ ሚኒስትር ክሪስ ራይት፣ አሜሪካ በቬንዙዌላ የነዳጅ ሀብት ላይ ትልቅ ድርሻ የምታገኝበትን አወዛጋቢ ስምምነት ይፋ ለማድረግ ወደ ሀገሪቱ ሊጓዙ ነው። በ100 ዓመት የሚቆየው ይህ ስምምነት አሜሪካ ከግል ድርጅቶች ጋር በመተባበር ከ17 የነዳጅ ማውጫ ቦታዎች ምርት እንድታወጣ የሚያስችል ነው። የቬንዙዌላ መንግስት ለኢኮኖሚው ጠቃሚ ነው ቢልም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ስምምነቱ ግልጽነት የጎደለው በመሆኑ እና ዝርዝር መረጃ ባለመቅረቡ ቅሬታቸውን እያሰሙ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Inaarjii Ameerikaa Kiris Raayit, Ameerikaan qabeenya boba'aa Veenzuweelaa irratti to'annoo guddaa akka argattu kan taasisu waliigaltee mormii guddaa kaase tokko ifa gochuuf gara biyyattii imaluuf jiru. Waliigalteen waggaa dhibbaa kun Ameerikaan dhaabbata dhuunfaa tokko waliin ta'uun iddoo boba'aa 17 keessaa oomisha akka baafattu kan hayyamuudha. Mootummaan Veenzuweelaa waliigalteen kun diinagdee biyyattii fayyada jedhee kan deggeru yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu waliigaltee kana keessa maal akka jiru ifatti waan hin beekamneef mormii guddaa qabu.

title: Urgent need for access to Iranian sites, cautions UN nuclear watchdog
english: The UN's nuclear watchdog has expressed deep concern regarding the lack of access to Iran's nuclear facilities, warning that this transparency gap poses a serious proliferation risk. Although Iran previously agreed to allow inspections, it is now restricting access to sites damaged by military strikes until new safety protocols are established. IAEA head Rafael Grossi continues to advocate for a formal, lasting diplomatic resolution to settle these ongoing verification issues.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኑክሌር ተቆጣጣሪ ኤጀንሲ በአይራን የኑክሌር ማዕከላት ላይ ያለው የመረጃ እና የቁጥጥር እጥረት ለኑክሌር መስፋፋት ስጋት እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። ኢራን ቀደም ሲል ተቆጣጣሪዎች ወደ ቦታው እንዲገቡ ብትፈቅድም፣ በወታደራዊ ጥቃት የተጎዱ ቦታዎችን ለመመርመር አዳዲስ መስፈርቶች እንደሚያስፈልጉ በመግለጽ ቁጥጥሩን ገድባለች። የኤጀንሲው ኃላፊ ራፋኤል ግሮሲ ጉዳዩ በዘላቂ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስምምነት እንዲፈታ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni nageenya niwukilaraa kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii (IAEA), Iran bakkeewwan ishee kan qorannoo niwukilaraa akka qoratamu hin hayyamne jechuun yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru. Kunis dhimmoota niwukilaraa irratti iftoomina dhabuun balaa niwukilaraa babal'isuu akka danda'u hubachiisaniiru. Iran gama ishiitiin, bakkeewwan waraanaan miidhaman qorachuun haala adda ta'een akka ta'u fi seera haaraa akka barbaachisu ibsiteetti; kanaanis daawwannaa dhaabbatichaa danqiteetti. Hogganaan IAEA, Raafa'el Goroosii, rakkoon kun marii fi walii galtee dippilomaasii waaraan akka hiikamu gaafatan.

title: Zelenskyy warns airlines as Ukrainian drones target Russian airspace
english: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has cautioned airlines that Russian airspace is becoming dangerous due to ongoing Ukrainian drone operations. He explained that these strikes are specifically intended to damage military facilities that assist Russia in its invasion of Ukraine. Consequently, commercial air travel in the region is facing increased risks as the drone campaign continues.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ የዩክሬን ድሮኖች በሩሲያ ላይ የሚያደርጉት ጥቃት ቀጥሎ ስለሚሄድ የሩሲያ የአየር ክልል ለሲቪል አውሮፕላኖች አደገኛ እየሆነ መምጣቱን አስጠነቀቁ። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ አቅም ለማዳከም የታለሙ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት በክልሉ የሚደረጉ የንግድ በረራዎች ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ስጋት እንደተጋረጠባቸው ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Volodimir Zelenski qilleensi naannoo Raashiyaa miidhaa droneen Yuukireen geessisaa jirtuun walqabatee, xiyyaarota siviliif balaa keessa galaa jiraachuu akeekkachiisaniiru. Haleellaan kunneenis bu'uuraalee waraanaa Raashiyaa kan weerara Yuukireen gargaaran irratti xiyyeeffatanii kan raawwataman ta'uu ibsaniiru. Kana irraa kan ka'e, yaaddoon nageenyaa balaliii xiyyaaraa naannichaa keessatti dabalaa jira.

title: Deadly car bomb attack at Colombia police station
english: A car bomb detonated outside a police station in Colombia, resulting in the death of one individual and leaving over ten others wounded. The force of the explosion was significant, with local residents comparing the impact to that of an earthquake. Authorities confirmed that among those injured are several members of the police force.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ በሚገኝ የፖሊስ ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረ የመኪና ቦምብ ፍንዳታ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ ከአስር በላይ የሚሆኑ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፍንዳታው በጣም ኃይለኛ ከመሆኑ የተነሳ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ላይ እንደ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ስሜት ተሰምቷል። ከተጎዱት መካከል የፖሊስ አባላት እንደሚገኙበት ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Kolombiyaatti buufata poolisii tokko biratti konkolaataa keessa hidhamee kan ture boombiin utuu dhuka’uu namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbeera, namoonni kudhan ol immoo miidhaniiru. Miidhaa dhuka’ichaa kan hubatan jiraattonni naannichaa akka socho’a lafaa (earthquake) cimaa ta’uu ibsaniiru. Namoota miidhaman keessa poolisoonni akka jiranis mirkanaa’eera.

title: US military says completed latest wave of strikes on Iran
english: The United States military recently launched a series of strikes targeting various facilities belonging to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. These attacks destroyed radar systems, air defenses, and communication sites, among other military assets. The U.S. government stated this action was taken in response to Iranian threats against commercial ships and American military personnel.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች ሰራዊት ኢላማዎች ላይ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶችን ማድረሱን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የራዳር ስርዓቶችን፣ የአየር መከላከያዎችን እና የመገናኛ ጣቢያዎችን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ወታደራዊ መሠረተ ልማቶችን አውድመዋል። አሜሪካ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደችው በንግድ መርከቦች እና በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ላይ ለደረሱ የኢራን ዛቻዎች ምላሽ ለመስጠት እንደሆነ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa qaamolee humna eegumsa jijjiirama Islaamaa kan Iraan irratti haleellaa geggeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Haleellaa kanaanis sirnoonni raadaaraa, ittisa qilleensaa fi iddoowwan quunnamtii dabalatee bu'uuraaleen waraanaa hedduun barbadeeffamaniiru. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, makiinoota daldalaa fi waraana Ameerikaa irratti doorsisa Iraan irraa dhufeef deebii kennuuf ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: No casualties, minimal damage from US attack on Jiroft Airport
english: Officials in Iran’s Kerman province confirmed that a recent American strike on Jiroft Airport resulted in no injuries or structural damage. A projectile impacted an area away from the main runway, and authorities report that the situation remains stable. The regional government stated that normal operations were not significantly impacted by the incident.
amharic: በኢራን ከርማን ግዛት የሚገኘው የጂሮፍት አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ በደረሰበት የአሜሪካ ጥቃት ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት አልጠፋም ወይም የንብረት ውድመት አልደረሰም። ሚሳኤሉ ያረፈው ከአውሮፕላን ማረፊያው ማኮብኮቢያ ውጭ መሆኑን የክልሉ ምክትል ገዥ አስታውቀዋል። አሁን ላይ ሁኔታው በቁጥጥር ስር እንደዋለና ስጋት እንደሌለ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni waraana Ameerikaa buufata xiyyaaraa Jiiroofti irratti haleellaa geggeesseen lubbuun namaa hin darbuu akkasumas miidhaan guddaan hin geenyu jedhameera. Kantiibaan ittaanaa ganda Kerman akka ibsanitti, meeshaan waraanaa buufaticha ala kan kute ta'uu fi haalli amma jiru tasgabbaa'aa akka ta'e beekameera. Haalli kun buufatichaa irratti miidhaa guddaa hin geessifne jedhamee gabaafameera.

title: Kuwait army says air defences responding to attacks
english: The Kuwaiti military announced that its air defense systems are currently engaging and intercepting hostile drones. Officials clarified that any loud explosions heard by residents are caused by these defensive operations. The public has been advised to remain calm and strictly follow all official safety guidelines.
amharic: የክዌይት ወታደራዊ ኃይል የአገሪቱን የአየር መከላከያ ስርአቶች በጠላት ድሮኖች ላይ በመጠቀም ምላሽ እየሰጠ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። የሚሰሙት የፍንዳታ ድምፆች የመከላከያ ሰራዊቱ ድሮኖቹን በመውረሱ ምክንያት የተከሰቱ መሆናቸውን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል። ህዝቡ መረጋጋትን እንዲጠብቅ እና ከባለስልጣናት የሚሰጡ የደህንነት መመሪያዎችን እንዲከተል ተጠይቋል።

Sagaleen dhohiinsa gurguddaa dhaga'amaa jiru kun ittisa xiyyaara malee fayyadamaa kanaa wajjin walqabatee kan uumame ta'uu aanga'oonni ibsaniiru. Uummanni nagaa isaa akka eeggatuufi qajeelfamoota nageenyaa mootummaan baasu hunda akka hordofu hubachiifameera.

title: Israel-Greece air defence deal to be 'scaled up' with UAE as contender, sources say
english: Israel is planning to expand its air defense export business following a recent multi-billion dollar deal with Greece. Officials indicate that the United Arab Emirates is being targeted as the next major customer to help them complete their layered defense network. These Israeli systems are considered highly attractive because they are more affordable and easier to export than comparable American technologies.
amharic: እስራኤል ከግሪክ ጋር የፈጸመችውን የብዙ ቢሊዮን ዶላር የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተከትላ የጦር መሣሪያ ኤክስፖርት ንግዷን ለማስፋፋት አቅዳለች። የተባበሩት አረብ ኢሚሬቶች ያሉባትን የመከላከያ ክፍተት ለመሙላት እስራኤልን እንደ ቀጣይ ገዢ እንደምትፈልግ ታውቋል። የእስራኤል የአየር መከላከያ ሥርዓቶች ከአሜሪካ ቴክኖሎጂዎች ጋር ሲነፃፀሩ ዋጋቸው አነስተኛ እና በቀላሉ ለውጭ ገበያ የሚቀርቡ በመሆናቸው ተመራጭ እንደሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Israa'el dhiyeenya kana Giriikii waliin waligaltee miiliyara hedduun shallagamu erga gootee booda, gabaa meeshaa waraanaa ishee babal'ifachuuf karoorsiteetti. Emiratonni Arabaa tokkoon tokkoon isaanii hanqina ittisa qilleensa isaanirra jiru guuttachuuf, Israa'el gabaa isaanii itti aanu akka taatu barbaadu. title: Iran says it launched drone attacks on US base in Bahrain
english: The Iranian military recently reported launching a significant drone strike against a United States air base located in Bahrain. The operation specifically targeted radar systems and areas housing American personnel at the Sheikh Isa Air Base. This facility is a crucial hub for U.S. military reconnaissance and aircraft maintenance in the Gulf region.

title: US launches more strikes on Iran as state media reports explosions
english: The United States military has launched new strikes against Iranian Revolutionary Guard targets following accusations of Iranian attacks on commercial ships and American personnel. Iran has vowed to retaliate against US interests in the region, leading to reports of explosions near several Iranian cities. This escalation marks a significant increase in tensions following the expiration of a previous ceasefire agreement between the two nations.

Irraan haleellaa kanaaf deebii akka kennituu fi buufatawwan Ameerikaa naannichaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa banuu ishee hordofee, magaalota Irraan tokko tokko keessatti sagaleen dhukaasaa fi dhohiinsaa dhaga'ameera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan dhufe walii galtee tasgabbii duraan ture erga xumuramee booda ta'uu isaa gabaafameera.

title: China’s Xi makes his first visit to Egypt in a decade
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping has arrived in Cairo for an official visit, marking the first time a Chinese leader has traveled to Egypt in ten years. He was received by Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi upon his arrival. This high-level meeting underscores a significant diplomatic engagement between the two nations after a long hiatus.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ሺ ጂንፒንግ በአስር ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ግብፅን በይፋዊ ጉብኝት ጎብኝተዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ካይሮ ሲደርሱ በግብፁ አቻቸው አብዱል ፈታህ አል-ሲሲ አቀባበል ተደርጎላቸዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲጠበቅ የነበረውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jinpiing waggaa kudhanii booda yeroo jalqabaaf biyya Masrii daawwataniiru. Pirezidaantichi Kaayiroo yeroo ga'an, pirezidaantii Masrii Abdulfattaah Al-Siisiin simannaa taasisaniifii jiru. Daawwannaan kun hariiroo dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru cimsuuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: Israel’s multiple wars see finance, defence ministries clash over spending
english: Israel's ongoing multi-front conflicts have sparked a major disagreement between the finance and defense ministries regarding ballooning military expenditures. While the military claims it is running out of funds and needs significantly more money to maintain national security, finance officials warn that these demands are fiscally unsustainable. Despite a massive increase in the defense budget to roughly $60.8 billion, the two sides remain at odds over how to manage the economic impact of these prolonged wars.
amharic: በእስራኤል እየተካሄዱ ባሉ ተከታታይ ጦርነቶች ምክንያት በመከላከያ እና በገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር መካከል ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት ተፈጥሯል። የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ለሀገር ደህንነት ሲባል ተጨማሪ በጀት እንደሚያስፈልገው ቢገልጽም፣ የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር በበኩሉ የወታደራዊ ወጪዎች መጨመር ለሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ አደገኛ እንደሆነ ያስጠነቅቃል። ምንም እንኳን የመከላከያ በጀቱ ወደ 60.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ቢጨምርም፣ በሁለቱ አካላት መካከል ያለው ውዝግብ አሁንም መፍትሄ አላገኘም።
oromo: Waraana gara garaa biyyattii keessatti adeemaa jiruun wal qabatee, ministeerri faayansii fi ministeerri ittisaa mootummaa Israa'el baasii waraanaa irratti wal dhabuun isaanii gabaafameera. Ministeerri ittisaa nageenya biyyaa eeguuf baajata dabalataa gaafachaa yoo jiru, ministeerri faayansii immoo baasiin akkasii kun dinagdee biyyattiif sodaachisaa akka ta'e akeekkachiiseera. Baajanni waraanaa gara dolaara biliyoona 60.8tti ol guddatee kan jiru ta'us, gareen lamaan kun rakkoo dinagdee mudate furuuf irratti waliigaluu hin dandeenye.

title: Hakainde Hichilema returns as Zambia’s president following disputed vote
english: Hakainde Hichilema has been inaugurated for a second term as Zambia's president following a contentious election. While he received 60 percent of the vote, the process has been marred by the arrest of his main political rival, Brian Mundubile, on treason charges and the closure of the country's courts. Despite these controversies and allegations of fraud, Hichilema promised to lead fairly and continue his efforts to strengthen the nation's economy.
amharic: ሃካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ አወዛጋቢ በሆነ ምርጫ ካሸነፉ በኋላ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የዛምቢያ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። በምርጫው ሂደት ዋና ተቀናቃኛቸው ብሪያን ሙንዱቢሌ በክህደት ወንጀል መታሰራቸው እና የሀገሪቱ ፍርድ ቤቶች መዘጋታቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት አስነስቷል። እነዚህን ክሶች ውድቅ ያደረጉት ፕሬዝዳንቱ፣ ምንም እንኳን የምርጫው ውጤት አከራካሪ ቢሆንም፣ በፍትሃዊነት እንደሚያስተዳድሩ እና የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ ለማሻሻል እንደሚሰሩ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Hakaayinde Hichilemaan filannoo falmisiisaa ta'e booda yeroo lammaffaaf pirezidaantummaa Zaambiyaatti deebi'anii muudamaniiru. Injifannoon isaanii kun morkataa isaanii guddaa Biriyaanii Munduubileen yakka gantootaatiin hidhamuu fi mana maree biyyattii cufamuu isaatiin kan faalame dha. Hichilemaan himannaa gowwoomsuu irratti dhiyaate kan morman yoo ta'u, waadaa walqixxummaan bulchuu fi diinagdee biyyattii fooyyessuu itti fufuuf galaniiru.

title: Three missiles intercepted over southern Syria
english: On Tuesday, three missiles were shot down while flying over the Daraa region in southern Syria. Reports indicate that these projectiles were originally intended to strike Jordan. No further details regarding the source of the attack or potential damage have been provided.
amharic: ማክሰኞ ዕለት በደቡባዊ ሶሪያ ዳራ በተባለ አካባቢ ሶስት ሚሳኤሎች በአየር ላይ ተመትተው ወድቀዋል። እነዚህ ሚሳኤሎች ኢላማቸው ጆርዳን እንደነበር ተገልጿል። ጥቃቱን ማን እንደፈጸመው እና የደረሰው ጉዳት መኖር አለመኖሩ እስካሁን አልታወቀም።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxata darbe, boombiiwwan sadii kibba Suuriyaa naannoo Daraa keessatti xiyyaaradhaan ykn meeshaa ittisaan qilleensa keessatti dhukaafamaniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, boombiiwwan kun kan qajjeelfaman gara biyya Yordaanositti ture. Namni ykn gareen haleellaa kana raawwate hin beekamu.

title: Sirens sound in Jordan
english: Emergency sirens were triggered in the Jordanian regions of Mafraq and Aqaba following Iran's announcement of retaliatory strikes against U.S. positions. Reports indicate that projectiles were intercepted over the city of Mafraq during the incident. The alerts were broadcast by Jordanian state media as regional tensions escalated.
amharic: ኢራን በአሜሪካ ጣቢያዎች ላይ የበቀል እርምጃ መውሰዷን ተከትሎ በዮርዳኖስ ማፍራቅ እና አቃባ ግዛቶች የአደጋ ጊዜ ማስጠንቀቂያ ደውሎች ተሰምተዋል። በማፍራቅ ከተማ የሮኬት ጥቃቶች መክሸፋቸውን ዘገባዎች ይጠቁማሉ። ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ በሄደበት በዚህ ወቅት የዮርዳኖስ የመንግስት ሚዲያ ህዝቡን ለማስጠንቀቅ እነዚህን ምልክቶች አስተላልፏል።
oromo: Iraaniin buufataalee Ameerikaa irratti tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu fudhachuu ishee hordofee, naannolee Yordaanos kan ta'an Maafiraaq fi Aqaabaa keessatti sagaleen akeekkachiisaa dhaga'ameera. Magaala Maafiraaq keessatti rookeetota qilleensa irra turan akka cufaman gabaasni ni ibsa. Yeroo waraana naannichaa kana keessatti, miidiyaan mootummaa Yordaanos haala kana uummataaf ibsuu yaaleera.

title: Death toll in Iran’s Sirik rises to four, including child
english: A U.S. military strike on a residence near the Iranian city of Sirik has resulted in the deaths of four individuals, including a child. The incident took place during a wedding ceremony and left more than 50 people injured. Emergency response teams are currently working at the scene to provide assistance.
amharic: በኢራን ሲሪክ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ በተፈጸመ የአሜሪካ ጥቃት አንድ ህፃንን ጨምሮ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በሰርግ ስነስርዓት ወቅት ሲሆን ከ50 በላይ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች በስፍራው በመካሄድ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humni waraana Ameerikaa magaalaa Sirik, Iran keessatti mana tokko irratti haleellaa raawwateen daa'ima tokko dabalatee namoonni afur du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun yeroo cidha tokkoo kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, namoonni 50 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Yeroo ammaa kanatti hojiin gargaarsa hatattamaa bakka sanaatti itti fufee jira.

title: Israel-Greece air defence deal to be 'scaled up' with UAE as contender, sources say
english: Israel is planning to expand its air defense system exports, using its recent multi-billion dollar deal with Greece as a template. Officials indicate that the United Arab Emirates is the primary target for this initiative, as both nations seek to fill gaps in the Emirates' layered defense network. This strategy aims to integrate Israeli military technology with regional partners to counter emerging security threats.
amharic: እስራኤል ከግሪክ ጋር የፈረመችውን የብዙ ቢሊዮን ዶላር የጦር መሣሪያ ስምምነት እንደ መነሻ በመጠቀም የአየር መከላከያ ሥርዓቶቿን ወደ ውጭ የመላክ ሥራዋን ለማስፋት እያቀደች ነው። አሁን ባለው ዕቅድ መሠረት የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስ ዋናው የገበያ ተጠቃሚ እንደምትሆን ተገልጿል። ይህ ስትራቴጂ የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ ቴክኖሎጂ ከክልሉ አጋሮች ጋር በማቀናጀት የጋራ ደህንነትን ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el waliigaltee meeshaa waraanaa biiliyoonaan lakkaa'amu kan Giriikii waliin mallatteessite ka'umsa godhachuun, sirnoota ittisa qilleensa ishee gara biyyoota biraatti gurguruu babal'isuuf karoorfattee jirti. Hojjettoonni mootummaa akka ibsanitti, Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii (UAE) gabaa ijoo kanaaf ta'uuf karoorfatameera. Tariiqiin kun teeknoolojii waraana Israa'el biyyoota ollaa waliin walitti muree fayyadamuun dhiibbaa nageenyaa harka caalu ittisuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: CBS staff accuse network of ‘overt racism’ over Abdul El-Sayed 9/11 story
english: CBS News is facing internal criticism from staff members who claim the network engaged in overt racism and poor journalism regarding its coverage of Muslim Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed. The controversy stems from an article that linked El-Sayed to 9/11 by highlighting his past social media posts about pandemic deaths, a decision reportedly pushed by editor-in-chief Bari Weiss. Employees and critics argue that the report is a coordinated smear campaign intended to undermine El-Sayed's candidacy by exploiting his religious and ethnic identity.
amharic: የሲቢኤስ ኒውስ የዜና አውታር በሙስሊሙ የሴኔት እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ ላይ ባቀረበው ዘገባ ግልጽ የሆነ ዘረኝነት እና ደካማ ጋዜጠኝነት አሳይቷል በሚል በውስጥ ሰራተኞቹ ተወቅሷል። ውዝግቡ የተቀሰቀሰው ኤል-ሰይድ ቀደም ሲል በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ የጻፏቸውን ጽሁፎች ከአሜሪካው የሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት ጋር በማያያዝ በዜና አውታሩ ዋና አዘጋጅ ባሪ ዋይስ ግፊት ዘገባው መሰራቱን ተከትሎ ነው። ሰራተኞች እና ተቺዎች ይህ ዘገባ የኤል-ሰይድን ማንነት እና ሃይማኖት በመጠቀም በእጩነቱ ላይ ጥላሸት ለመቀባት የታቀደ ስም ማጥፋት ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ።
oromo: CBS News hojjattoota isaatiin dhimma dorgomaa Senaata kan ta'an Abdul El-Sayed irratti gabaasa 'irra-daddarbee mul'atu' kan qabu fi gabaasa gaarii hin taane dhiyeessitanii jirtu jedhamee komatamaa jira. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan uumame gabaasa El-Sayed ergaawwan miidiya hawaasaa isaa duraan barreesse, kanneen du'a vaayrasii koronaa fi haleellaa Septeember 11 wal-bira qaban, gabaasa 9/11 wajjin wal-qabsiisee gabaasuudhaani. Hojjattoonni fi namoonni gabaasa kana morman, qajeelfama Bari Weiss jedhamuun qophaa'e kun, eenyummaa fi amantii El-Sayed fayyadamuun filannoo isaa mancaasuuf kan karoorfamee dhiyaate akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: #ትሰማ Unmasks a Power Struggle Over Culture in Ethiopia
english: The Ethiopian #ትሰማ (Let Her Be Heard) campaign is calling for urgent government action to address systemic failures in prosecuting gender-based violence. While supporters emphasize the need for accountability and justice for victims, critics express concern that the movement reflects an unwanted influence of Western cultural norms. Ultimately, the campaign has sparked a complex national debate regarding the balance between traditional values and modern calls for institutional reform.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያው #ትሰማ ንቅናቄ በሴቶች ላይ የሚደርስ ጥቃትን ለመከላከልና ተገቢውን ፍትሕ ለማረጋገጥ መንግሥት አፋጣኝ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ እየጠየቀ ነው። የንቅናቄው ደጋፊዎች ለጉዳዩ ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጥ ሲወተውቱ፣ ተቺዎች ግን ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የምዕራባውያን ባህል ተጽዕኖ እንዳለበት ይከራከራሉ። በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ እየተካሄደ ያለው ክርክርም በአገሪቱ ነባር እሴቶችና በዘመናዊ የፍትሕ ሥርዓት ለውጥ መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት በግልጽ አሳይቷል።
oromo: Sochii #ትሰማ kan Itoophiyaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun, miidhaa dubartoota irra ga'uuf furmaata akka kennamuufi qaamoleen mootummaa itti gaafatamummaa akka fudhatan gaafachaa jira. Deggeroonni isaa sirna haqaa cimaa barbaaduu isaanii yoo ibsan, mormitoonni garuu sochichi dhiibbaa aadaa lixaa keessa galuu isaa shakkidu. Walumaagalatti, sochiin kun miidhaa dubartoota irratti xiyyeeffatuus, aadaa fi jijjiirama ammayyaa gidduutti falmii bal'aa umee jira.

title: Exam Reforms Aren’t Fixing Ethiopia’s Institutional Decay
english: Despite recent government efforts to tighten exam security and reduce cheating in Ethiopia, the country's education system continues to face deep-seated moral and institutional issues. While moving national exams to university campuses significantly lowered cheating, the resulting failure rates reveal that students have not been adequately prepared to think critically or act with integrity. Ultimately, the article argues that schools are failing to teach essential values like honesty, as the current system rewards shortcuts over actual learning.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የትምህርት ሥርዓት ፈተናን ከመስረቅ ለመከላከል የተወሰዱ እርምጃዎች ቢኖሩም፣ በአገሪቱ ተቋማት ውስጥ ያለው የሥነ-ምግባር መሸርሸር አሁንም አሳሳቢ ነው። የፈተና አሰጣጥ ሥርዓቱ ቢሻሻልም፣ አብዛኞቹ ተማሪዎች አጥጋቢ ውጤት ማምጣት አለመቻላቸው የትምህርት ጥራቱ እና የተማሪዎች የመማር ችሎታ ከፍተኛ ችግር እንዳለበት ያሳያል። ትምህርት ቤቶች ስለ ታማኝነት እና ስለ ሀላፊነት ከማስተማር ይልቅ፣ ለውጤት ብቻ የሚሮጡበት ሁኔታ መፈጠሩ ተማሪዎችን ለችግሩ ዋነኛ ተጠቂ አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Itoophiyaa qormaata biyyoolessaa irratti gowwoomsaa fi hatuu hambisuuf carraaqqii taasise illee, sirni barnootaa rakkoo amalaafi bu'uuraa cimaa keessa jira. Qormaata yunivarsitii keessatti kennuun hatuu hir'isuu danda'us, barattoonni hedduun qabxii darbaa fiduu dadhabuun isaanii barnoonni bu'uuraa akka hin jirree fi barattoonni gahumsa akka hin qabne mirkaneessa. Manneen barnootaa dhugaa dubbachuu fi itti gaafatamummaa barsiisuu mannaa, qabxii qofaaf akka dorgoman taasisuun isaanii guddinaafi amala gaarii barattootaa irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisaa jira.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's current political climate in Tigray is drawing comparisons to the period that led to Eritrea's independence due to the ongoing exclusion of the region from national processes. The National Dialogue Commission has failed to include key armed and political groups, leaving Tigray without representation in government, elections, or national discussions. Experts warn that by repeating past mistakes of marginalization and superficial dialogue, the current administration risks destabilizing the nation's future.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ በትግራይ ክልል ላይ እየተወሰዱ ያሉት የፖለቲካ እርምጃዎች፣ የኤርትራን መገንጠል ካስከተሉት ታሪካዊ ስህተቶች ጋር እየተመሳሰሉ ነው። የኢትዮጵያ ብሄራዊ ምክክር ኮሚሽን ቁልፍ የሆኑ የፖለቲካ እና የትጥቅ ቡድኖችን ማካተት ባለመቻሉ፣ ትግራይ በምርጫም ሆነ በሀገራዊ ውይይቶች ላይ ተሳትፎ እንዳይኖራት አድርጓል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ መንግስት ያለፈውን ታሪክ በመዘንጋት እና ክልሎችን በማግለል የሚሄድ ከሆነ የሀገሪቱን ሰላም ለአደጋ ሊያጋልጥ ይችላል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa keessatti haalli siyaasaa naannoo Tigraayirratti mul’atu, rakkoolee darban kanneen gara bilisummaa Eertiraatti geessisan waliin wal fakkaachaa jira. Komishiniin Marii Biyyooleessaa gareewwan siyaasaa fi hidhattoota ijoo ta’an hirmaachisuu waan dadhabeef, Tigraay filannoo fi marii biyyoolessaa keessatti bakka bu’iinsa dhabdeetti. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, mootummaan dogoggora darbe irraa barachuu diduun naannolee baasanii uummuun, fuuldura biyyattii rakkoo keessa galchuu danda’a.

title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
english: German authorities have officially blamed Russia for a recent failed drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport, citing clear intelligence evidence of sabotage. In retaliation, Germany is shutting down a Russian consulate and terminating the contract for the Russian House in Berlin over concerns regarding espionage. Russia has denied these allegations and vowed to retaliate against Germany's decision to tighten security and diplomatic restrictions.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት በቅርቡ በ ላይፕዚግ/ሃሌ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ ለተፈጸመው ያልተሳካ የድሮን ጥቃት ሩሲያ ተጠያቂ መሆኗን በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። ለዚህም ምላሽ ጀርመን የስለላ ስራዎችን በመስራት ተጠርጥረው የነበሩ የሩሲያ ተቋማትን በመዝጋት በሩሲያ ዲፕሎማቶች ላይ የጉዞ ገደቦችን ጥላለች። ሩሲያ ክሱን ውድቅ ያደረገች ሲሆን በጀርመን እርምጃ ላይ ተመሳሳይ የመልስ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስፈራርታለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Jarman miidhaa qilleensa irraa gara buufata xiyyaaraa Leipzig/Halletti qaqqabeef Itoophiyaa osoo hin taane, Ruusiyaan itti gaafatamtuu akka taate mirkaneesseera. Jarman tarkaanfii kanaan walqabatee bakka bu'oota Ruusiyaa fi dhaabbata 'Russian House' jedhamu kan biyyattii keessatti socho'aa ture cufuuf murteessiteetti. Ruusiyaan himannaa kana kan haalte yoo ta'u, Jarman irratti haaloo bahuuf akka kaatte ibsiteetti.

title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
english: A hydropower worker in Nepal narrowly escaped a tunnel after sudden, deadly flash floods from the Trishuli River caused a catastrophic collapse. As he fled the rising waters for twenty minutes, he discovered that the disaster had destroyed his home and claimed the lives of several family members. Rescue operations remain ongoing at various tunnel sites, where hundreds of laborers are still missing following the floods that have resulted in over 1,000 deaths across the country.
amharic: በኔፓል በትሪሹሊ ወንዝ ላይ የተከሰተ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ በሃይድሮ ኤሌክትሪክ ዋሻ ውስጥ ሲገባ አንድ ሰራተኛ በጭንቅ ተረፈ። ሰራተኛው ለሃያ ደቂቃ ያህል ከሚመጣው የጎርፍ ውሃ ሲሸሽ ቆይቶ፣ በኋላ ላይ ቤቱ መፍረሱንና የቤተሰቡ አባላት ህይወት ማለፉን ለማወቅ ችሏል። በሀገሪቱ ከ1,000 በላይ ሰዎችን የገደለው ይህ አደጋ በዋሻዎች ውስጥ በመስራት ላይ የነበሩ መቶዎችን አሁንም አጠፋፋቸዋል፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችም ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan projekti hidha bishaan irraa humna ibsaa maddisiisuu tokko Nepaal keessatti, lolaa tasaa laga Trishuli irraa ka’eefi gara holqa hojii isaa seenen lubbuun hafe. Namichi kun bishaan lolaa isaa duukaa bu’e jalaa daqiiqaa 20f yeroo dheeratu, mana isaa diigameefi maatiin isaa irraa du’an arguun gadda guddaaf saaxilame. Balaa kana keessatti namoonni 1,000 ol du'aniiru; hojjettoonni hedduunis holqa keessatti dhabamanii, waraanni fi ogeeyyiin dhimmi isaa ilaallatu barbaacha itti fufanii jiru.

title: Vance calls Michigan Senate candidate El-Sayed 'evil' at campaign rally
english: US Vice-President JD Vance publicly attacked Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed at a rally, labeling him an evil and divisive figure. The conflict intensified after El-Sayed allegedly questioned how Vance's family would perceive his wife's background, prompting a sharp rebuke from Vance. In response, El-Sayed defended himself by characterizing the Trump administration's political agenda as harmful and morally wrong.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ በምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ላይ የሚቺጋኑን የሴኔት እጩ አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድን ክፉ እና አገርን የሚከፋፍል ሰው ሲሉ ከሰሷቸው። ግጭቱ የጋለፈው ኤል-ሰይድ የቫንስ ቤተሰብ ስለ ባለቤታቸው አስተዳደግ ያላቸውን አመለካከት በመጠየቃቸው ሲሆን፣ ቫንስም ለዚህ ጠንካራ ምላሽ ሰጥተዋል። አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ በበኩላቸው የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የሚያራምዳቸው ፖሊሲዎች ጎጂ እና መጥፎ እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance walgahii filannoo irratti, kaadhimamaa seenaatii kan Michigan Abdul El-Sayed nama hamaa fi biyya diigudha jechuun ceephataniiru. Walitti buutiin kun kan dhalate erga El-Sayed maatiin Vance waa'ee haadha manaa isaanii ilaalcha akkamii qabu jechuun gaaffii kaasee booda. Vance gaaffii kanaaf deebii cimaa kenneen booda, El-Sayed ammoo siyaasni bulchiinsa Trump miidhaa geessisaa fi naamusa kan hin qabne jechuun deebiseef.
