title: Pitso Mosimane appointed by South Africa ahead of AFCON qualifiers
english: Pitso Mosimane has been named the new head coach of the South Africa national football team, taking over from Hugo Broos. The veteran manager, who is highly decorated at the club level, has been signed to lead the team through the 2030 World Cup. He now faces the urgent task of preparing the squad for their upcoming 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying match against Guinea.
amharic: ፒትሶ ሞሲማኔ ከሁጎ ብሩስ በመረከብ የደቡብ አፍሪካ ብሄራዊ ቡድን ዋና አሰልጣኝ ሆነው ተሾመዋል። በክለብ ደረጃ ትልቅ ስኬት ያስመዘገቡት የ62 አመቱ አሰልጣኝ፣ እስከ 2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ድረስ ቡድኑን እንዲመሩ ውል ተፈራርመዋል። አሰልጣኙ በአሁኑ ወቅት የ2027 የአፍሪካ ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ የመጀመሪያ ጨዋታቸውን ከጊኒ ጋር የሚያደርጉበትን ቡድን የማዘጋጀት ፈታኝ ተግባር ይጠብቃቸዋል።
oromo: Pitson Mosimaane leenjisaa garee kubbaa miilaa biyyoolessa Afrikaa Kibbaa ta'uun Hugo Broos bakka bu'eera. Leenjisaan muuxannoo qaban kun, hanga waancaa addunyaa bara 2030tti garee kana akka hoogganan waliigalteerrä gahuun beekameera. Amma garuu qophiin yeroo gabaabaa keessatti xumuramee tapha calallii waancaa Afrikaa bara 2027 kan Ginii waliin ta'uuf xiyyeeffannaa kennuun irra jiraata.

title: China’s Xi makes first visit to Egypt in a decade, amid regional turmoil
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping has arrived in Cairo for his first visit in ten years to celebrate 70 years of diplomatic relations with Egypt. The two leaders aim to strengthen their strategic partnership and discuss international issues during this time of regional instability. Furthermore, the visit highlights growing economic ties, with China serving as a major investor and trading partner for Egypt, particularly in the Suez Canal zone.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዚዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ ከግብፅ ጋር ያላቸውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት 70ኛ ዓመት ለማክበር በአስር ዓመት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ካይሮ ተጉዘዋል። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በክልሉ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ወቅት ስልታዊ አጋርነታቸውን ለማጠናከር እና በጋራ ጉዳዮች ላይ ለመወያየት አቅደዋል። ጉብኝቱም በተለይም በሱዌዝ ካናል ቀጠና ውስጥ የቻይና ኢንቨስትመንትና የሁለቱን አገራት የንግድ ግንኙነት ይበልጥ ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jinpiing waggaa 70ffaa hariiroo diippiloomaasii Gibxii waliin qaban kabajuuf gara Kaayiroo imalaniiru. Hogganoonni lameen kun yeroo ammaa naannichatti rakkoolee uumaman jiran irratti mari'achuufi walitti dhufeenya guddina biyyoota isaanii cimsuuf kaayyeffataniiru. Imalli kun hariiroo daldalaafi invastimantii cimaa biyyoonni kunneen qaban, keessattuu naannoo daandii galaana Suweez irratti babal'isuuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: Ousted UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer to quit domestic politics
english: Former UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer has announced his resignation as a member of parliament after serving for 11 years. Following his departure from the premiership earlier this summer due to declining political support, he intends to shift his focus toward global issues like international security and trade. This decision will trigger a by-election to fill his vacant seat in London.
amharic: የቀድሞው የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኬይር ስታርመር ለ11 ዓመታት ሲያገለግሉ የቆዩበትን የፓርላማ አባልነት እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል። ቀደም ሲል በፖለቲካዊ ድጋፍ ማጣት ምክንያት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትርነታቸውን ለቀው የነበረው ስታርመር፣ አሁን ትኩረታቸውን በአለም አቀፍ የደህንነት እና የንግድ ጉዳዮች ላይ ለማድረግ አቅደዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በለንደን ባለው ወንበር ላይ ሌላ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ ያደርጋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii UK Keir Starmer waggoota 11 booda miseensummaa paarlaamaa gadhiisuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Waggoota muraasa dura deeggarsa siyaasaa dhabuun muummicha ministeerummaarraa erga bu'anii booda, amma xiyyeeffannoo isaanii dhimmoota addunyaa kan akka nageenyaa fi daldalaa irratti gochuuf murteessaniiru. Murteen kun bakka isaanii bakka buusuuf filannoo biroo akka gaggeeffamu taasisa.

title: US launches new strikes against Iran as war escalates
english: The United States military conducted major strikes against the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps following threats to American troops and regional shipping. Iran has vowed to retaliate, despite warnings from President Trump that any counterattack would result in even more severe military consequences. The U.S. government has also advised its citizens in the Middle East to remain vigilant due to the heightened risk of conflict.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች እና በመርከቦች ላይ የተቃጡ ጥቃቶችን ተከትሎ በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ኢራን ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ ቃል ብትገባም፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢራን የበቀል እርምጃ ከባድ አጸፋ እንደሚያስከትል አስጠንቅቀዋል። አሜሪካ በበኩሏ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚገኙ ዜጎቿ የጸጥታ ስጋት ሊኖር ስለሚችል ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Humnooti waraana Ameerikaa loltoota isaanii fi dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti miidhaan erga qaqqabee booda, garee 'Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' (IRGC) jedhamu irratti haleellaa cimaa raawwataniiru. Itoophiyaan keessattuu namoonni mootummaan Itoophiyaa irraa deebii kennuuf waadaa seenanillee, pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraampii yoo deebii kennan haleellaa kana caalu akka mudatu akeekkachiisaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa lammiileen isaa naannoo Baha Giddugaleessaa keessa jiran, balaa waraanaa kanarraa kan ka'e akka of eeggannoo cimaa godhatan akeekkachiiseera.

title: IAEA reports progress in Syria investigation, none in Iran
english: The UN nuclear watchdog has successfully closed its investigation into Syria's historical secret nuclear program. In contrast, the agency reported no progress regarding Iran, noting that it still lacks the necessary access to monitor uranium levels. This ongoing lack of transparency in Iran continues to be a major source of concern for nuclear proliferation.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የኒውክሌር ተቆጣጣሪ ኤጀንሲ በሶሪያ የቀድሞ የኒውክሌር እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ ሲያደርግ የነበረውን ምርመራ በስኬት ማጠናቀቁን አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል በኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ላይ ምንም አይነት መሻሻል አለመኖሩን እና የዩራኒየም ክምችትን ለመቆጣጠር በቂ መዳረሻ እንደሌላቸው ገልጿል። ይህ በኢራን በኩል ያለው የመረጃ ግልጽነት ማጣት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mootummoota gamtoomaniifila hordoffii niwukilaraa, qorannoo waggoota darban Itoophiyaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa ture xumuruu isaa beeksisera. Gama biraatiin, Iran keessatti guddinni tokkollee akka hin jirre fi hanga yuraaniyamiis hordofuu akka hin dandeenye ibsameera. Haala Iran keessatti mul'atu kanaan, sodaan faca'iina meeshaalee niwukilaraa akka itti fufe jira.

title: IRGC say US will 'regret' renewed attacks
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has threatened retaliation against the United States following recent strikes near the Strait of Hormuz. Despite warnings from the American leadership, Iranian officials claimed they are planning a significantly larger counter-attack against regional U.S. interests. This escalation heightens tensions as both nations trade warnings regarding future military actions.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች ሠራዊት በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ በተካሄዱት የአሜሪካ ጥቃቶች የተነሳ የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል። የአሜሪካ መንግሥት የሰጠውን ማስጠንቀቂያ ችላ በማለት፣ ኢራን በአካባቢው የሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ጦር ሰፈሮች ላይ ከባድ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር እቅድ እንዳላት ገልጻለች። ይህ ሁኔታ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humni Eegumsa Islaamummaa Iraan (IRGC) weerara Yunaayitid Isteetsi daangaa Hormuzitti raawwatte hordofee haaloo akka baasu dhaadate. Hogganoonni Iraan akeekkachiisa mootummaa Ameerikaa irraa kennameefis osoo hin harka kennatin, buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa kan naannichatti argaman irratti weerara hammaataa ta'e akka raawwatan dubbataniiru. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru daran kan hammaachiseedha.

title: Trump warns of 'much harder' action if Iran retaliates after strikes
english: Former President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning to Iran, stating that any retaliation for recent U.S. airstrikes will result in even more severe military consequences. These initial American attacks were launched in response to Iranian involvement in attacks against a U.S. base in Jordan. Trump cautioned that further escalation could lead to devastating damage to the nation of Iran.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ በተፈጸሙ የአየር ጥቃቶች ላይ በቀል የምትወስድ ከሆነ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚጠብቃት አስጠንቅቀዋል። እነዚህ የአሜሪካ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ቤዝ ላይ ለተፈጸመው ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው። ትራምፕ አክለውም ኢራን ተጨማሪ ጥቃት ብትሰነዝር ሀገሪቱ ከፍተኛ ጥፋት እንደሚገጥማት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidantii duraanii Doonald Traamp, Iraan weerara qilleensaarraa kan Ameerikaan gaggeessiteef deebii yoo kennite, tarkaanfii waraanaa cimaa ta'een akka adabamtu akeekkachiisaniiru. Weerari Ameerikaa kun kan raawwatame buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Yordaanos keessa jiru irratti miidhaan erga ga'ee booda ture. Traamp itti dabaluun, Iraan weerara kana caalaatti itti fufte, biyyi sun miidhaa hamaa akka keessummeessitu ibsaniiru.

title: US army secretary resigns amid signs of Pentagon unease with Iran war
english: US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has resigned following internal disagreements with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth regarding the ongoing war with Iran. Military leaders have expressed concern that prolonged operations are depleting critical weapons stockpiles and undermining the nation's readiness to address other global threats. This departure highlights growing friction within the administration over war strategy and the sustainability of current military commitments.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የጦር ሠራዊት ሚኒስትር ዳን ድሪስኮል ከአሜሪካ-ኢራን ጦርነት ጋር በተያያዘ ከመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴት ጋር በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል። የጦር መሪዎች ጦርነቱ እየተራዘመ መምጣቱ ለሀገሪቱ ወሳኝ የሆኑ የጦር መሳሪያዎች ክምችት እንዲሟጠጥ እና ለሌሎች ስጋቶች የመከላከል አቅምን እንዲቀንስ እያደረገ ነው የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። ይህ መልቀቂያ በመንግስት አስተዳደር ውስጥ ስለ ጦርነቱ ስልት እና ስለ ወታደራዊ ዝግጁነት ያለው ልዩነት እየሰፋ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministirri Waraana Ameerikaa Dan Dristkol, waraana Iran wajjin jiru ilaalchisee ministira ittisaa Pit Hegseth waliin wal-dhabdee uumameen booda aangoo gadhiiseera. Hogganoonni waraanaa, waraanni kun dheerachuu isaan, meeshaalee waraanaa barbaachisoo ta'an akka dhumanii fi dandeettii biyyattii kan biroo ittisuuf qabdu akka laaffisu yaadda'anii jiru. Gadi-lhiisuun kun, mootummaan waraana Iran irratti tarkaanfii fudhatu irratti fi qophii waraanaa irratti wal-dhabdee keessa jiraachuu isaa ifa godha.

title: US State Department issues security alert for citizens in Middle East
english: The US State Department has issued a safety warning for American citizens throughout the Middle East due to rising regional instability. Travelers are advised to stay alert as military actions, including recent strikes against Iran, could lead to sudden flight cancellations or airspace restrictions. Authorities emphasized that the security situation is volatile and could escalate unexpectedly.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መሥሪያ ቤት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው የጸጥታ መደፍረስ ምክንያት በዚያ ለሚገኙ ዜጎቹ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥቷል። በኢራን ላይ የተወሰዱትን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ተከትሎ በረራዎች ሊሰረዙና የአየር ክልል ሊዘጋ ስለሚችል ተጓዦች ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ ተመክሯል። ወቅታዊው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ አደገኛ እና በማንኛውም ሰዓት ሊባባስ እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessatti sodaa nageenyaa uumame hordofee lammiilee isaa achi jiranuf akeekkachiisa baaseera. Tarkaanfiin waraanaa Iran irratti fudhatame dhiibbaa uumuu danda'uuf, balalliiwwan xiyyaaraa fi cufiinsi qilleensa irraa waan mul'achuu danda'uuf namoonni of eeggannoo cimaa akka taasisan gorfamaniiru. Haalli nageenyaa naannichaa tasgabbii kan hin qabne fi yeroo kamiyyuu kan hammaachuu danda'u ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
english: Spanish prosecutors report that sexual assaults, including those involving minors, have become a daily occurrence in the enclave of Ceuta following a massive surge of migrants. Authorities believe the actual number of incidents is likely higher, as many victims are afraid to report these crimes due to their precarious legal status. In response, the government is providing emergency aid to support vulnerable migrants while facing significant political pressure to resolve the ongoing border crisis.
amharic: በሴኡታ ግዛት ውስጥ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች መጉረፍ ሳቢያ፣ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በየቀኑ የጾታዊ ጥቃት ድርጊቶች እየተፈጸሙ መሆናቸውን የስፔን አቃቤ ህጎች አስታውቀዋል። ብዙዎቹ ተጎጂዎች በህገ-ወጥ የኑሮ ሁኔታቸው ምክንያት ፍርሃት ስላደረባቸው ድርጊቱን ለፖሊስ እንደማያሳውቁና ይህም የተመዘገበውን ቁጥር ከፍ ሊያደርገው እንደሚችል ተገልጿል። መንግስት ለችግሩ መፍትሄ ለመስጠት ድንገተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ በአስቸጋሪው የድንበር ቀውስ ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ተቃውሞ እየገጠመው ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ispeen akka ibsetti, godaantota Ceuta gahan keessatti miidhaan saalaa, kanneen ijoollee dabalatu, guyyaa guyyaan raawwatamaa jiraachuu beekameera. Godaantonni hedduun haala seeraan alaa waan jiraniif, sodaa irraa kan ka'e yakka kana gabaasuu akka hin dandeenyeefi lakkoofsi dhugaa isaa kana caaluu akka danda'u himameera. Mootummaan rakkoo kana furuuf gargaarsa ariifataa godhaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, dhimma daangaa kana ilaalchisee mormii cimaa siyaasaa keessa galeera.

title: Israel says senior Hamas member seized as strikes kill three during Gaza raid
english: Israeli defense officials confirmed the capture of a high-ranking Hamas operative following a specialized military operation in Gaza City. The raid triggered intense aerial bombardment, which local health officials report resulted in the deaths of three civilians, including two children. While Israel maintains that its forces are actively targeting Hamas leadership and infrastructure, Palestinian authorities stated the operation was compromised after the special unit was discovered.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር በጋዛ ከተማ በተካሄደ ልዩ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ከፍተኛ የሃማስ አመራር መያዙን አረጋግጠዋል። ዘመቻው ባስከተለው ከባድ የአየር ድብደባ ሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ሶስት ንጹሃን ዜጎች መገደላቸውን የሀገር ውስጥ የጤና ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። እስራኤል የሃማስን መዋቅር ለማፈራረስ እየሰራች መሆኗን ስትገልጽ፣ የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው ልዩ ኃይሉ በዘመቻው ወቅት መጋለጡን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti duula addaa geggeeffameen hoogganaan garee Hamaas tokko qabamuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Duuluma kanaan walqabatee haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatameen ijoollee lama dabalatee namoonni sadii lubbuun darbaniiru. Israa'el tarkaanfichii kaayyoo shororkeessummaa dhabamsiisuuf akka ta'e ibsituus, qaamoleen falasxiin gama isaaniin gareen addaa kun erga beekamee booda haleellaan sun akka jabaate ibsaniiru.

title: Russian attack hits rail workers in new deadly strikes on Kyiv
english: Russian overnight missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas have resulted in at least 12 deaths and 20 injuries, including several railway employees. The attack damaged residential buildings and infrastructure as part of an ongoing campaign to weaken Ukrainian defenses and energy facilities. This surge in violence follows recent international calls, including from India’s Prime Minister, for a peaceful resolution to the conflict.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢው ባደረሰችው የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎች መሞታቸው እና 20 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። በጥቃቱ የባቡር ሰራተኞች እና የመኖሪያ ቤቶች ተጎድተዋል፤ ይህ ድርጊት የዩክሬንን የመከላከያ አቅም ለማዳከም የታለመ የዘመቻ አካል እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈፀመው የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትርን ጨምሮ ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎች ጦርነቱ እንዲቆም ጥሪ ካቀረቡ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Rusiyan halkanii halkan magaalaa Kiyivii fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi droomiin geessisteen lubbuun namoota 12 yoo darbu, 20 ol madaa’aniiru. Haleellaan kun hojjettoota baaburaa fi manneen jireenyaa kan miidhe yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas ittisa biyyattii fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa laaffisuudha. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame hogganoonni biyyoolessaa, dabalataanis muummichi ministeeraa Indiyaa waraana kana akka dhaaban erga gaafatanii booda.

title: Football Fandom: Who owns your loyalty?
english: The latest episode of Doha Debates explores the profound influence football fandom has on personal identity and community belonging. The program examines why people form deep emotional attachments to clubs and how this loyalty shapes their worldview. Through this discussion, the show questions the deeper significance of sports passion in our modern lives.
amharic: የዶሃ ክርክሮች አዲሱ ክፍል የእግር ኳስ አድናቂነት በግለሰብ ማንነት እና በማህበረሰብ ስሜት ላይ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ተጽእኖ ይዳስሳል። ሰዎች ከእግር ኳስ ክለቦች ጋር ለምን ጥልቅ ስሜታዊ ትስስር እንደሚፈጥሩ እና ይህ ታማኝነት በአለም አመለካከታቸው ላይ ምን ተጽእኖ እንዳለው ይተነትናል። በዚሁ ውይይት አማካኝነት ፕሮግራሙ በዘመናዊ ህይወታችን ውስጥ ለስፖርት ያለን ፍቅር ያለውን ጥልቅ ፋይዳ ይፈትሻል።
oromo: Sagantaan 'Doha Debates' guyyaa har'aa, jaalalli kubbaa miilaa eenyummaa fi miira walitti hidhamiinsa hawaasummaa irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabu qorata. Namoonni garee kubbaa miilaatiif maaliif miira gadi fagoo akka qabaatan fi amanamummaan kun akkaataa itti addunyaa hubatan irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabu xiinxala. Marii kana keessatti, sagantichi jireenya keenya har'aa keessatti jaalalli ispoortii hiika akkamii akka qabu gaaffii keessa galcha.

title: Barcelona sign Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal for a reported $11.6m
english: Barcelona has officially acquired Brazilian striker Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal for approximately $11.6 million on a contract lasting until 2029. The club turned to Jesus as an alternative after failing to secure Julian Alvarez from Atletico Madrid to strengthen their attacking line. Coach Hansi Flick expressed excitement about the signing, noting that the player's style is a great fit for the team's tactics.
amharic: ባርሴሎና የብራዚላዊውን አጥቂ ገብርኤል ጄሱስን ከአርሰናል በ11.6 ሚሊየን ዶላር እስከ 2029 በሚቆይ ውል ማስፈረሙን ይፋ አድርጓል። ክለቡ ይህንን ዝውውር የፈጸመው ከአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ ጁሊያን አልቫሬዝን ለማስፈረም ያደረገው ሙከራ ስላልተሳካ የፊት መስመር ጥቃቱን ለማጠናከር ነው። የቡድኑ አሰልጣኝ ሀንዚ ፍሊክ የተጫዋቹ የጨዋታ ዘይቤ ለቡድኑ ፍልስፍና ተስማሚ በመሆኑ በዝውውሩ መደሰታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Barcelona weeraraa biyya Brazil Gabri'eel Jeesusis kilabii Arsenal irraa doolaara miiliyoona 11.6 ta'uun hanga bara 2029tti isa tursiisuun mallatteessiseera. Kilabichi murtoo kana kan godhe erga Atleetikoo Maadrid irraa Juuliyaan Aalvaarez gahuu dadhabee booda, sarara dursaa isaa cimsuuf jecha ture. Leenjisaan garee kanaa Haanzii Fliik akka ibsanitti, akaakuun tapha taphataa kanaa tarsiimoo garee isaanii wajjin waan wal simatuuf, dhufaatiin isaa fayyadamummaa guddaa akka qabu dubbataniiru.

title: Who is Alejandro Betancourt, ex-Chavez ally now Trump’s Venezuela oil man?
english: Alejandro Betancourt, a controversial businessman known for his past ties to Venezuela's former government, has been chosen by the Trump administration to lead a major U.S.-backed oil project. This deal allows the U.S. to take significant control over Venezuela's oil reserves through Betancourt’s energy company. Although he is a powerful figure, Betancourt has faced numerous international allegations regarding corruption and money laundering throughout his career.
amharic: አሌሃንድሮ ቤታንኮርት የተባሉ አወዛጋቢ የንግድ ሰው፣ ከቀድሞው የቬኔዝዌላ መንግስት ጋር በነበራቸው ግንኙነት ይታወቃሉ። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር አሁን በቬኔዝዌላ በሚካሄድ ትልቅ የነዳጅ ፕሮጀክት ላይ እንዲመሩ መርጠዋቸዋል። ይህ ስምምነት አሜሪካ በቤታንኮርት የነዳጅ ኩባንያ በኩል የቬኔዝዌላን የነዳጅ ክምችት እንድትቆጣጠር ያስችላታል። ቢሆንም፣ ቤታንኮርት በሙስና እና በገንዘብ ማጠብ ወንጀል ከተለያዩ ሀገራት ምርመራ ሲካሄድባቸው የቆዩ ሰው ናቸው።
oromo: Alejandro Betancourt namicha daldalaa cimaa fi wal-falmisiisaa yoo ta'u, kanaan dura mootummaa Venezueelaa waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qaba ture. Mootummaan Donald Trump proojektii boba'aa guddaa Venezueelaa keessatti gaggeeffamu akka dursu filatee jira. Waligalteen kun Ameerikaan qabeenya boba'aa Venezueelaa irratti to'annoo akka qabaattu kan taasisu yoo ta'u, namichi kunis duula kana keessatti gahee guddaa qaba. Haa ta'u malee, Betancourt hojii isaa keessatti himannaa malaammaltummaa fi qabeenya seeran alaa qulqulleessuu hedduu mudatee jira.

title: Napoli’s ex Man Utd star McTominay needs surgery for irregular heartbeat
english: Napoli midfielder and former Manchester United player Scott McTominay is set to undergo a minor surgery to correct an irregular heartbeat. The Scottish international will be sidelined from professional play until October as he recovers from the procedure. He is expected to return to the pitch following the conclusion of the upcoming international break.
amharic: የናፖሊው አማካይ እና የቀድሞው የማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ ተጫዋች ስኮት ማክቶሚናይ፣ የልብ ምት መዛባትን ለማስተካከል በቀዶ ጥገና ሕክምና እንዲያደርግ ተወስኗል። የስኮትላንድ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አባል የሆነው ይህ ተጫዋች፣ ከቀዶ ጥገናው በኋላ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማገገም እስከ ጥቅምት ወር ድረስ ከሜዳ ይርቃል። ከዓለም አቀፍ የጨዋታ እረፍት በኋላ ወደ ሜዳ እንደሚመለስ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Taphataan giddu galeessa Napoli fi durii Manchester United kan ta'e Scott McTominay, dhukkuba onnee isaa waliin walqabatu wal'aanuuf baqaqsanii hodhuu akka godhuuf murtaa'eera. Taphatichi biyya Iskootlaandi kun, erga wal'aansa isaa xumuree booda hanga ji'a Onkoloolessaatti dirree taphaatii kan irraa fagaatu ta'a. Hojii isaa idilee kan itti fufuufis xumura boqonnaa tapha biyyoolessaa irratti akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: How wildfires are scorching France’s wine industry
english: France's renowned wine industry is facing significant threats as climate change leads to record-breaking heat and intense wildfires. These extreme temperatures cause grapes to ripen too quickly, altering their chemical balance and alcohol levels. Furthermore, massive wildfires have destroyed vast areas of land, particularly impacting iconic wine-producing regions like Bordeaux.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ታዋቂ የወይን ኢንዱስትሪ በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት በከፍተኛ ሙቀት እና በሰደድ እሳት ስጋት ላይ ወድቋል። ከፍተኛው የሙቀት መጠኑ ወይኖች በፍጥነት እንዲበስሉ በማድረግ ጣዕማቸውን እና የአልኮል ይዘታቸውን እንዲቀይር አድርጓል። በተጨማሪም፣ ሰፊ የደን ቃጠሎዎች በተለይም እንደ ቦርዶ ባሉ ታዋቂ የወይን ምርት አካባቢዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ውድመት አስከትለዋል።
oromo: Indastiriin wayinii Faransaay kan beekamu, jijjiirama qilleensaa irraa kan ka'e ho'a guddaa fi ibidda bosonaa sodaachisaa ta'een miidhamaa jira. Ho'i kun firii wayinii saffisaan akka bilchaatu taasisuun, qabiyyee isaa fi alkoolii isaa jijjiireera. Kana malees, ibidda bosonaa babal'ataa dhufeen, keessattuu naannolee wayinii akka Bordootti lafa hedduu gubee balleesseera.

title: The final minutes before floodwater crashed through Nepal-China border
english: A massive flash flood containing mud, ice, and heavy boulders devastated the border area between Nepal and China on August 26, destroying the vital Friendship Bridge and nearby customs facilities. CCTV footage and satellite images confirm that the surge of water swept away buildings along the valley floor in both Gyirong and Rasuwagadhi. Authorities are currently working to determine the fate of many people, including numerous travelers and pilgrims, who were in the region when the disaster occurred.
amharic: ነሐሴ 20 ቀን በኔፓል እና በቻይና ድንበር አካባቢ የተከሰተ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ ጭቃን፣ በረዶን እና ግዙፍ ድንጋዮችን በመያዝ የሁለቱን አገራት ድንበር የሚያገናኘውን ድልድይና የጉምሩክ ተቋማትን አውድሟል። የካሜራ ምስሎች እና የሳተላይት መረጃዎች ጎርፉ በጂሮንግ እና በራስዋጋዲ አካባቢ የሚገኙ ሕንፃዎችን በሙሉ ጠራርጎ መውሰዱን ያሳያሉ። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ወቅት በስፍራው የነበሩ ተጓዦችን እና ነዋሪዎችን ሁኔታ ለማጣራት እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Muddee 20, biyyoota Neephaal fi Chaayinaa gidduutti lolaan tasa ka'e biyyee, cabbii fi dhagaa gurguddaa of keessatti qabatee gandaa fi buufataalee daangaa irratti argaman guutummaatti barbadeesseera. Suuraawwan kaameroota CCTV fi marsaa samiirraa kaafaman akka agarsiisanitti, lolaan kun ganda Gyirong fi Rasuwagadhi keessa kan turan ijaarsaalee hunda haxaa'ee darbeera. Yeroo ammaa mootummaan namoota yeroo lolaa sana achi turan, kanneen akka imaltootaa fi namoota biroo hubachuuf qorannoo gochaa jira.

title: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
english: A former gang leader named Duane Davis has been convicted for his role in the 1996 drive-by shooting that killed hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. Although Davis did not pull the trigger himself, prosecutors successfully argued that he orchestrated the attack and provided the weapon used by his nephew. This verdict finally resolves a nearly 30-year-old cold case that had remained one of the most mysterious crimes in music history.
amharic: ዱዌን ዴቪስ የተባሉ የቀድሞ የቡድን መሪ እ.ኤ.አ. በ1996 በላስ ቬጋስ የሂፕ-ሆፕ ኮከቡን ቱፓክ ሻኩርን በመግደል ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ዴቪስ ራሳቸው ጥይቱን ባይተኩሱም፣ ጥቃቱን በማቀናበር ለወንድማቸው ልጅ መሳሪያውን እንዳቀበሉ አቃቤ ህጎች በማስረጃ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ላለፉት 30 ዓመታት መፍትሄ ሳይበጅለት የቆየውን እና የሙዚቃውን ዓለም ሲያነጋግር የነበረውን ታዋቂ የወንጀል ክስ የቋጨ ነው።
oromo: Duwaan Deevis kan jedhaman hoogganaan garee kaleessaa, bara 1996 magaala Las Veegasitti ajjeechaa weellisaa beekamaa Tupaak Shaakur irratti raawwatamee ture qindeessuun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Deevis ofumaan rasaasa dhukaasuu baatanis, ajjeechaa kana qindeessanii fi meeshaa waraanaa ilmi obboleessa isaanii itti fayyadame dhiyeessuu isaanii abbaan alangaa ragaadhaan mirkaneessaniiru. Murtii kanaan waggoota 30 oliif utuu hin furamin turee fi seenaa muuziqaa keessatti kan nama ajaa'ibu ture, xumura argateera.

title: Amazon rigged $20bn worth of ad prices, US lawsuit alleges
english: The US Federal Trade Commission and 22 states have filed a lawsuit accusing Amazon of manipulating advertising auctions to unfairly inflate prices. The complaint alleges that the company secretly overcharged businesses by replacing auction results with higher figures, potentially generating $20 billion in extra profit since 2019. Amazon has denied these claims, arguing that the lawsuit is based on a misunderstanding of how their advertising platform operates.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ንግድ ኮሚሽን እና 22 ግዛቶች አማዞን የማስታወቂያ ጨረታዎችን በማጭበርበር ዋጋውን ያለ አግባብ ከፍ አድርጓል በሚል ክስ መስርተዋል። ኩባንያው ከ2019 ጀምሮ የጨረታ ውጤቶችን በመቀየር ከደንበኞቹ እስከ 20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ተጨማሪ ትርፍ አግኝቷል ተብሎ ይከሰሳል። አማዞን በበኩሉ ይህ ክስ የተሳሳተ መሆኑን እና የማስታወቂያ መድረኩን አሠራር በተሳሳተ መንገድ መረዳታቸውን በመግለጽ ውንጀላውን አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Komishiniin Daldala Federaalaa Ameerikaa fi namoonni biroo 22, Amazon gabaa beeksisaa keessatti gatii dabarsuun soba raawwate jechuun himatanii jiru. Himatni kun akka jedhutti, Amazon bara 2019 irraa eegalee bu'aa caalbaasii beeksisaa jijjiiruun qarshii biiliyoona 20 ol ta'u hatattamaan bu'aa guddaa akka argate ibsa. Amazon gama isaatiin himata kana kan mormu yoo ta'u, himatni kun mala itti fayyadama beeksisa isaanii hubachuu dhabuu irraa kan maddeedha jedhee deebiseera.

title: Israeli attacks on Gaza kill at least four, including children
english: Israeli military drone strikes in Gaza have resulted in at least four deaths, including two children, and left several others injured. The attacks occurred across different locations, notably in the al-Kateeba district of Gaza City and Deir el-Balah. While Israel claims these operations were conducted to neutralize threats, the intensity of the drone strikes caused significant chaos and destruction in the area.
amharic: በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል፤ ከተገደሉት መካከል ሁለት ሕፃናት ይገኙበታል። ጥቃቶቹ በጋዛ ከተማ አል-ካቲባ አውራጃ እና በዴር ኤል-ባላህ አካባቢ የተፈጸሙ ናቸው። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው ስጋት ያላቸውን ኢላማዎች ለማስወገድ እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ የተጠናከረው የድሮን እንቅስቃሴ በቦታው ላይ ከፍተኛ ሁከትና ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Hojiin weerara xiyyaara kashilaa (drone) Israa'el daangaa Gaazaatti geggeessiteen lubbuun namoota afur yoo darbu, isaan keessaa lama ijoollee dha. Haleellaan kun magaalota Gaazaa fi Deer el-Balaah keessatti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, namoota hedduu miidhee jira. Israa'el haleellaa kana kan raawwatte sodaa jiru hambisuuf ta'uu ibsituus, sochii xiyyaara kashilaa cimaa ta'een naannichatti jeequmsaa fi miidhaan guddaan uumamee jira.

title: Football power struggle caused FIFA World Cup plan fallout, says Kushner
english: Joshua Kushner, a prominent venture capitalist, has expressed regret over his involvement in a failed FIFA plan to sell World Cup commercial rights to private investors. He blamed the project's collapse on complex political conflicts within global football and claimed his firm would have avoided the deal had they foreseen the intense backlash. Meanwhile, UEFA is pursuing legal action against FIFA President Gianni Infantino, alleging the secret proposal amounted to criminal mismanagement.
amharic: ታዋቂው የኢንቨስትመንት ባለሙያ ጆሹዋ ኩሽነር፣ የዓለም ዋንጫን የንግድ መብቶች ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ታቅዶ የነበረው እና ውድቅ የሆነው የፊፋ ፕሮጀክት ውስጥ በመሳተፋቸው መጸጸታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የፕሮጀክቱ መክሸፍ በዓለም አቀፍ እግር ኳስ ውስጥ ባለው የተወሳሰበ የፖለቲካ ፍጥጫ ምክንያት እንደሆነ የገለጹት ኩሽነር፣ ጉዳዩ ይህን ያህል ውዝግብ እንደሚያስነሳ አስቀድመው ቢያውቁ ኖሮ ከዚህ ስምምነት ይርቁ እንደነበር ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ዩኤፋ የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በድብቅ ባቀረቡት በዚህ ሀሳብ ላይ የወንጀል ክስ ለመመስረት እንቅስቃሴ ጀምሯል።
oromo: Hojjetaan invastimantii beekamaan Jooshuwaa Kushnar, sagantaa FIFA kan dursee qophaa'ee ture fi mirga daldalaa Waldaa Kubbaa Miilaa Addunyaa (World Cup) investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfame keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitti gaabbuu ibsaniiru. Kufaatiin sagantichaa walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa kubbaa miilaa addunyaa keessa jiruun kan dhufe ta'uu fi rakkoo kana duraan beekanii utuu ta'ee, dhaabbanni isaanii dhimma kana keessa akka hin galle dubbataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Yuuefaan (UEFA) pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo irratti himata yakkaa banuuf qophii taasisaa jira; kunis dhimmi kun iccitiin kan qophaa'e fi bulchiinsa sirrii hin taane akka ta'e himachuudhaani.

title: Russian drone and missile barrage kills at least 12 in Ukraine’s Kyiv
english: A massive overnight Russian aerial attack involving missiles and drones has killed at least 12 people and injured many others in Kyiv and its surrounding regions. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemned the violence as terrorism and urged international allies to urgently strengthen the country's air defense systems. The strikes caused significant damage to residential buildings and infrastructure, while retaliatory Ukrainian drone attacks were also reported inside Russian territory.
amharic: በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢው የተፈጸመው ግዙፍ የሩሲያ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ 12 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎችም ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን የሽብር ተግባር በማለት ያወገዙ ሲሆን፣ አጋር ሀገራት የዩክሬንን የአየር መከላከያ አቅም በአስቸኳይ እንዲያጠናክሩ ጠይቀዋል። ጥቃቱ በመኖሪያ ቤቶች እና በሌሎች መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያደረሰ ሲሆን፣ በምላሹም ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን ፈጽማለች።
oromo: Halkan darbetti biyyi Raashiyaa xiyyaara malee (drones) fi misaa'elii fayyadamuun magaalaa Kiyivii fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa geggeessiteen namoonni 12 ol du'anii, hedduun isaanii immoo miidhaniiru. Preezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zelenskii haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, biyyoonni michuu ta'an kan Yukreen dandeettii ittisa qilleensa ishee akka cimsattuuf gargaarsa akka godhan gaafataniiru. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti miidhaa guddaa kan geessise yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin Yukreenis daangaa Raashiyaa keessatti haleellaa deebii dronootaan geggeessitee jirti.

title: Heavy monsoon rains submerge Islamabad roads and underground
english: Severe monsoon rains have caused significant flooding across Islamabad and Rawalpindi in Pakistan, leading to submerged streets and water entering homes. In response to the dangerous conditions and rising water levels, local authorities have decided to shut down schools. The extreme weather has disrupted daily life in both cities as emergency teams deal with the impact of the downpour.
amharic: በፓኪስታን ኢስላማባድ እና ራዋልፒንዲ ከተሞች የጣለው ከባድ የዝናብ ወቅት ጎርፍ መንገዶችን በማጥለቅለቅ ወደ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ገብቷል። በጎርፉ ምክንያት የተፈጠረውን አደጋ ለመከላከል እና የውሃው መጠን እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ ባለስልጣናት ትምህርት ቤቶችን ዘግተዋል። ይህ የአየር ሁኔታ ለሁለቱ ከተሞች ነዋሪዎች ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan yeroo gannaa Paakistaan magaalaawwan Islamaabaad fi Raawalpindii keessatti bal’inaan roobee, daandiiwwan akka guutuufi manoota keessatti akka seenu taasiseera. Haala sodaachisaa fi lolaan dabalaa dhufu kana hordofee, qaamoleen mootummaa manneen barnootaa akka cufan ajajaniiru. Hawaasni naannichaa balaa rooba kanaan miidhamuu isaatiin jireenyi guyyuu isaanii guutummaatti addaan citeera.

title: ‘Not welcome’: How Sweden’s far right took over Stockholm Central Station
english: The Sweden Democrats, a far-right political party, recently launched an aggressive advertising campaign at Stockholm Central Station and on local buses targeting immigrants with exclusionary rhetoric. The posters, which call for the repatriation of individuals of Somali heritage and criticize migrants for various social issues, have caused significant distress among immigrant communities. While some transit operators removed the controversial ads following protests from staff, the campaign highlights the rising influence of the far-right party ahead of the upcoming national elections.
amharic: የስዊድን ዴሞክራቶች የተሰኘው እጅግ አክራሪ የፖለቲካ ቡድን፣ በስቶክሆልም ማዕከላዊ ባቡር ጣቢያ እና በአውቶቡሶች ላይ ስደተኞችን የሚያገል ማስታወቂያ ዘመቻ አድርጓል። ሶማሊያዊ ተወላጆች ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ የሚጠይቁት እና ስደተኞችን በወንጀልና በሌሎች ጉዳዮች የሚከሱት እነዚህ ማስታወቂያዎች፣ በስደተኛ ማህበረሰቡ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋትና ብስጭት ፈጥረዋል። አንዳንድ የትራንስፖርት ተቋማት ተቃውሞዎችን ተከትሎ ማስታወቂያዎቹን ለማስወገድ ቢገደዱም፣ ይህ ድርጊት ግን ከመጪው ምርጫ በፊት የስዊድን እጅግ አክራሪ ፓርቲዎች ተጽዕኖ እያደገ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin mirga-xumuraa 'Sweden Democrats' jedhamu, buufata baaburaa giddu-galeessa Stockholm fi konkolaataalee ummataa irratti duula beeksisoota godaantota jibbuu fi baasu irratti xiyyeeffatu gaggeesseera. Beeksisootni kun lammiilee seenaa Somaaliyaa qaban gara biyya isaaniitti akka deebi'an kan gaafatuu fi godaantota yakka fi rakkoolee biroo keessatti qooda qabu jechuun kan komatu dha. Gariin dhaabbilee geejjibaa mormii hojjettootaa booda beeksisoota kana buusuu kan dirqaman yoo ta'u, gochi kun filannoo biyyoolessaa dhufu dura dhiibbaan paartilee mirga-xumuraa Swiidin keessatti dabalaa dhufuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Israeli strikes pound Gaza, killing at least two children
english: Recent Israeli military strikes across Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least two children. The attacks caused significant chaos in densely populated areas, forcing the evacuation of a school and a field hospital. While Israel stated the operations were intended to eliminate security threats, the situation remains unstable as medical facilities continue to treat those injured.

title: Ben Gvir bars Jewish anti-Zionist movement from carrying guns
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has expanded a policy that makes it easier for civilians to obtain gun licenses to include the city of Beit Shemesh. However, he specifically excluded the anti-Zionist ultra-Orthodox group Neturei Karta from this program. Ben Gvir justified this decision by labeling the group as enemies due to their public opposition to the state and their support for Palestinian causes.

oromo: Ministirri nageenya biyyaa Israa'el Itamar Ben Gvir seera namootni hedduun meeshaa waraanaa akka hidhatan hayyamu gara magaalaa Beet Shemeshitti bal'iseera. Haa ta'u malee, garee amantii Neturei Karta kan Israa'elittii fi Si'onizimii mormu ta'e sirna kana keessaa baaseera. Ministirichi murtee kana kan dabarse, gareen kun mootummaa Israa'el mormuufi gama Falastiiwotaa deeggara jechuun akka diinaatti waan ilaaluufi.

title: Why China-Egypt cooperation has nothing to do with great-power rivalry
english: China and Egypt are celebrating 70 years of diplomatic relations, with many Western observers incorrectly viewing the partnership as a tool for geopolitical rivalry. In reality, the collaboration is focused on practical development, such as the successful Teda Suez industrial zone and essential transport infrastructure like Cairo's light rail. These projects prioritize Egypt's long-term economic growth and industrial independence rather than acting as a simple extension of superpower competition.

oromo: Chaayinaan fi Gibxi waggaa 70ffaa walitti dhufeenya dippilomaasii isaanii kabajaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, biyyoonni lixaa tokko tokko walitti dhufeenya kana akka morkii humnoota gurguddoo addunyaatti ilaalu. title: Iran has enough foreign currency despite US sanctions, central bank chief says
english: The Governor of Iran's Central Bank stated that the country possesses adequate foreign currency reserves to withstand ongoing US sanctions. He plans to release up to $2 billion into the market to stabilize currency fluctuations. While acknowledging economic difficulties, he dismissed concerns about a national financial collapse as mere psychological pressure.

title: Top Israeli intelligence official secretly traveled to US for 'sensitive' talks: Report
english: The director of Israel's Shin Bet security agency, David Zini, recently made a private trip to Washington, D.C. During his visit, he held high-level meetings with officials from the FBI. While the specific topics remain undisclosed, reports describe the discussions as involving sensitive security matters.
amharic: የእስራኤል የደህንነት አገልግሎት ሺን ቤት ኃላፊ ዳዊት ዚኒ በድብቅ ወደ ዋሽንግተን ዲሲ ተጉዘዋል። በጉብኝታቸው ወቅትም ከአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ምርመራ ቢሮ (FBI) ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ጋር ተገናኝተው መክረዋል። ምንም እንኳን የተወያዩባቸው ጉዳዮች በግልፅ ባይገለፁም፣ ንግግሮቹ ስሱ በሆኑ የደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ያተኮሩ እንደነበሩ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata nageenyaa Israa'el 'Shin Bet' Daawit Ziinii, icciitiidhaan gara magaalaa Waashingitan imalee jira. title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
english: Over six million Afghans have been forced to return to their home country from Pakistan and Iran due to strict crackdowns on migrants. Many of these individuals, including those born abroad who have never lived in Afghanistan, are arriving with no resources and nowhere to stay. International organizations describe this as an unprecedented humanitarian crisis, as these families struggle to survive in a nation already facing severe poverty.
